name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (POWERS, IMMUNITIES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 2026.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Provincial Assembly (Powers, Immunities and Privileges) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act defines the powers, immunities, and privileges of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Provincial Assembly, its Committees, and its Members. It establishes provisions regarding attendance in court, exemption from civil or criminal action, security status, and procedures for handling breaches of privilege.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA AASAN KAROBAR ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Aasan Karobar Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework to reform the regulatory regime for business, trade, and investment in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It creates the Aasan Karobar Portal as a one-window digital platform to streamline processes like registration, licensing, and certification.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA TRADE TESTING BOARD ACT, 2025.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Trade Testing Board Act, 2025
metadata.amends: National Training Ordinance, 1980
metadata.repeals: National Training Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Act re-constitutes the Trade Testing Board in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to assess and certify youth acquiring technical and vocational skills. It establishes the Board as a body corporate with powers to manage assets, appoint employees, and regulate training institutes within the province.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Climate Action Board Act, 2025

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Climate Action Board Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Climate Action Board as a body corporate to coordinate and oversee climate strategies across government departments. It defines the board's composition, powers, functions, and financial mechanisms to mitigate climate risks and promote sustainable development within the province.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2025

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No XI of 2005
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Government Servants Housing Foundation to provide residential plots to government servants on a no-profit, no-loss basis. It outlines the foundation's structure, including the Board of Directors and Managing Director, and details provisions for membership, fund management, and plot allotment.

name: Amendment in Section 417 in the “Criminal Procedure Code, 1898"

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2005 to update various sections regarding roles, powers, and procedures. Specific changes include substituting terms like 'Senior' for 'Additional', modifying conditions for withholding prosecution, and revising rules on police misconduct and withdrawal of charges.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA JUDICIAL OFFICERS WELFARE FUND ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Judicial Officers Welfare Fund Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Judicial Officers Welfare Fund to provide financial support and assistance to judicial officers and their families. It covers scenarios such as health emergencies, accidents, deaths, natural disasters, and post-retirement benefits, while also defining the fund's management, contribution methods, and investment rules.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA PARKS AND HORTICULTURE ACT, 2024

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Parks and Horticulture Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Parks and Horticulture Authority in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to regulate, develop, and maintain parks, green belts, and green areas. It also provides for the regulation of billboards, sky-signs, outdoor advertisements, and matters connected therewith.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA FINANCE ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act continues, revises, and exempts certain taxes, fees, and cess in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It amends various existing provincial and West Pakistan acts related to stamp duty, urban immovable property tax, motor vehicles taxation, and revenue authority registration.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA AGRICULTURAL INCOME TAX ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Agricultural Income Tax Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the imposition of a tax on agricultural income within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It defines key terms such as agricultural income, cultivated land, and assessors, while establishing rules for assessment, collection, and penalties related to non-compliance.

name: THE CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa) (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 by inserting a new section regarding the power to transfer cases to Special Courts. It grants the High Court authority to transfer cases from the Court of Session or between Special Courts in the interest of justice.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA LAWS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Laws (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act enables elected Advisors and Special Assistants to the Chief Minister in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to chair meetings of various Commissions, Boards, Authorities, Councils, Committees, and Sub-Committees. It amends existing laws to legally authorize these officials to preside over such bodies for administrative convenience and the best interest of the public.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA OVERSEAS PAKISTANIS COMMISSION ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Overseas Pakistanis Commission within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The Commission is empowered to receive and redress grievances of Overseas Pakistanis regarding Government Agencies and refer their complaints to concerned offices.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA EMPLOYEES (REMOVAL FROM SERVICE) ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Employees (Removal from Service) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act declares the appointments of certain employees made during the tenure of the Caretaker Government as unlawful and void from the beginning. It applies to all employees appointed through initial recruitment against regular posts in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province between January 22, 2023, and February 29, 2024, excluding specific categories such as those recommended by the Public Service Commission or appointed under court orders.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Animals Feed Stuff and Compound Feed Act, 2024

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Animals Feed Stuff and Compound Feed Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the manufacture, storage, supply, and transport for sale of livestock, poultry, and fish feed stuff and compound feed in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes standards for production and quality while prohibiting adulteration, misbranding, and hoarding of feed ingredients.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Provincial Assembly Secretariat Employees (Terms and Conditions of Services) Act, 2024

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Provincial Assembly Secretariat Employees (Terms and Conditions of Service) Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the terms and conditions of service for employees of the Provincial Assembly Secretariat in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It covers matters including appointment, probation, promotion, pay, termination, and conduct as required by the Constitution.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA FINANCE ACT, 2024.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act continues, revises, and exempts certain taxes, fees, and cess in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It also amends various existing provincial and West Pakistan acts regarding stamp duties, property tax, motor vehicle taxation, and finance schedules.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Service Tribunal Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Service Tribunals Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Service Tribunals to exercise exclusive jurisdiction over matters relating to the terms and conditions of service for civil servants in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It defines the composition, tenure, and appointment procedures for Tribunal Chairmen and members, including provisions for ad hoc appointments and acting chairmen.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA REGISTRATION OF BRICK KILNS ACT, 2024

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Registration of Brick Kilns Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a comprehensive system for the registration and regulation of brick kilns within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It mandates that all brick kilns be deemed as industries and requires operators to obtain a valid registration certificate before establishing or operating facilities, while also outlining procedures for renewal, compliance with other laws, and penalties for violations.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA ANIMAL WELFARE ACT, 2024

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Animal Welfare Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes standards for the humane handling, care, treatment, and transportation of animals within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It creates an Animal Welfare Committee to oversee these standards and defines various offences related to animal cruelty, including animal fighting ventures and unnecessary infliction of pain.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA ZOONOTIC DISEASE CONTROL ACT, 2024

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Zoonotic Disease Control Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act regulates and controls zoonotic diseases within the livestock sector of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes administrative structures, including a Centre and a Committee, to manage disease prevention, control measures, and inter-provincial trade regulations.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Livestock Breeding Services Act, 2024

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Livestock Breeding Services Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act regulates livestock breeding services within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to improve genetic potential and protect indigenous breeds. It establishes a committee, sets standards for breeding animals, mandates registration and licensing for breeders and facilities, and outlines penalties for violations.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA EMPLOYEES OF TRANSPORT DEPARTMENT (REGULARIZATION OF SERVICES) (REPEAL) ACT, 2024

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Employees of Transport Department (Regularization of Services) (Repeal) Act, 2024
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Employees of Transport Department (Regularization of Services) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Employees of Transport Department (Regularization of Services) Act, 2022. It declares that the repealed employees are deemed to have never been regularized or appointed against posts under the previous law.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA FINANCE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1996
metadata.summary: This Act amends section 11 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1996. It substitutes specific clauses regarding tobacco types and snuff/naswar with new tax rates per kilogram.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA LIMITATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2016

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Limitation (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: Limitation Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Limitation Act, 1908 by deleting Articles 147 and 148 from Part-IX of its First Schedule. It received assent on August 19, 2016, and came into force immediately.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA SALES TAX ON SERVICES ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Sales Tax on Services Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act reforms the law relating to sales tax on services within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It provides for the imposition, payment, and collection of such taxes along with connected matters.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA FINANCE ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2022
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. V of 1982; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1996; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. IV of 2000; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. VIII of 2010
metadata.summary: This Act continues, revises, and exempts certain taxes, fees, and cess in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It also establishes provisions for the efficient and transparent management of the Provincial Consolidated Fund and Public Accounts.

name: THE CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa) (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 by adding specific subjects to section 14A. The added subjects include forest, mines and minerals, food adulteration, food safety, encroachments on public lands, waterways, canal and drainage, motor vehicles, building control, and municipal services.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA PARTNERSHIP (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Partnership (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Partnership Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Partnership Act, 1932 to facilitate online registration and alteration of firm details. It introduces provisions for NADRA verification, electronic generation of registration certificates, and digital signing of documents.

name: The Registration Act, 1908

metadata.title: The Registration Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for the registration of documents in Pakistan, defining compulsory and optional registration requirements. It outlines the duties of registering officers, procedures for presenting documents, and rules regarding fees and penalties.

name: Land Acquisition (Mines) Act 1885

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (Mines) Act, 1885
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal provisions for cases where mines or minerals are situated under land intended to be acquired under the Land Acquisition Act. It outlines procedures for giving notice before working mines, determining compensation for injuries to mines, and granting powers to the Provincial Government to inspect mine workings and prevent damage to acquired land.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA FINANCE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.amends: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2013 to revise and continue certain taxes in the province. It specifically updates the First Schedule by adding new classifications for electronic billboards, e-media advertisements, and various service providers.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DESERVING WIDOWS AND SPECIAL PERSONS WELFARE FOUNDATION ACT, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Deserving Widows and Special Persons Welfare Foundation Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Deserving Widows and Special Persons Welfare Foundation to provide financial assistance, training, tools, equipment, shelters, and enterprises for deserving widows and special persons in the province. The legislation defines the composition of the Board, outlines its powers and functions, and sets up the administrative structure including a Fund and audit mechanisms.

name: THE SUCCESSION (KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Succession (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa) (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: Succession Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Succession Act, 1925 to facilitate the issuance of letters of administration and succession certificates by the National Database Registration Authority (NADRA). It empowers NADRA to issue these documents based on Family Registration Certificates in accordance with existing ordinances and rules.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the delimitation of local councils, including village, neighbourhood, tehsil, and district councils, for elections in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes the powers and procedures of the Election Commission of Pakistan to conduct this delimitation process.

name: The Code Civil Procedure (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa) (Amendement) Act, 2019

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa) (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 by adding a new sub-section to section 115. The amendment applies provisions from section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1908 to specific applications under the amended section.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA MEDICAL RELIEF ENDOWMENT FUND (REPEAL) ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Medical Relief Endowment Fund (Repeal) Act, 2022
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Medical Relief Endowment Fund Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Medical Relief Endowment Fund Act, 2004, rendering the previous fund mechanism redundant due to the existence of the Sehat Card Plus Programme. Upon repeal, the Fund is immediately transferred to the Provincial Consolidated Fund, with specific instructions for closing bank accounts and settling audit matters.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA EMPLOYEES SOCIAL SECURITY ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Employees Social Security Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides social security benefits to employees and their dependents in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It covers events such as sickness, maternity, employment injury, and death, establishing a governing body and an institution to manage these provisions.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION AND SUCCESSION CERTIFICATES ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a mechanism for the issuance of Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates to legal heirs of deceased individuals. It creates a Succession Facilitation Unit within the National Database and Registration Authority to process applications, assess claims, and maintain records while aiming to curb fraud and forgery.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA AMENDMENT OF CERTAIN FISCAL LAWS ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Amendment of Certain Fiscal Laws Act, 2021
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1990; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain fiscal laws in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, specifically regarding urban immovable property tax and finance acts. It updates validity dates, adjusts tax liability assessment procedures for specific commercial properties, and modifies rebate percentages for taxpayers.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA REGULARIZATION OF SERVICES OF EMPLOYEES OF SETTLEMENT OPERATIONS AND REVENUE ACADEMY ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Regularization of Services of Employees of Settlement Operations and Revenue Academy Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services of employees appointed on a contract basis in the Settlement Operations and Revenue Academy. It deems these employees to have been validly appointed on a regular basis from their initial appointment date, subject to specific conditions regarding qualifications and conduct.

name: THE [KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA] HYDEL DEVELOPMENT FUND ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Hydel Development Fund Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a specific fund for the development of hydel electricity within Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It creates a Board to manage the fund, defines its functions, and sets rules regarding project approval, financial contributions from profits, and expenditure limits.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Factories Act, 2013.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Factories Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of labour in factories within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and covers matters connected thereto. It establishes preliminary definitions, outlines health and safety provisions, restricts working hours, and sets penalties for contraventions.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA INDUSTRIAL RELATIONS ACT 2010

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Industrial Relations Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act formulates the law relating to the formation of trade unions and regulates their activities within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It also establishes legal frameworks for improving relations between employers and workmen, as well as mechanisms for avoiding and settling industrial disputes.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA REGULARIZATION OF SERVICES OF PROJECT EMPLOYEES OF THE DIRECTORATE GENERAL LIVESTOCK AND DAIRY DEVELOPMENT (EXTENSION) OF ERSTWHILE FEDERALLY ADMINISTERED TRIBAL AREAS ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Regularization of Services of Project Employees of the Directorate General Livestock and Dairy Development (Extension) of Erstwhile Federally Administered Tribal Areas Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Regularization of Services of Employees of Erstwhile Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment and regularization of services of contract-based project employees in the Directorate General Livestock and Dairy Development (Extension) of the Erstwhile Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It deems these employees to have been validly appointed on a regular basis upon verification of their credentials, while also outlining general conditions such as qualification requirements and the exclusion of those who resigned due to misconduct.

name: Prohibition of Firing and use of Explosive Substance at Marriages and other Ceremonies) Act, 1988.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Prohibition of Firing and Use of Explosive Substance at Marriages and Other Ceremonies) Act, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the firing of firearms and the use of explosive substances during marriages and other ceremonies to prevent danger to life or property. It establishes penalties for offenders, including imprisonment or fines, and grants police powers to arrest without a warrant.

name: Civil Servants (Regularization of Services) Act ,1988

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Civil Servants (Regularization of Services) Act, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services of certain civil servants who were appointed on an ad hoc basis. It establishes rules for determining their seniority relative to other regular civil servants and specifies that their services are deemed regularized upon publication in the official Gazette.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA UNIVERSAL HEALTH COVERAGE ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universal Health Coverage Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universal Health Coverage Policy Board to provide health protection to permanent resident families in the province. It creates the Sehat Card Plus Programme, which offers a basic package of free healthcare services and an optional additional package to registered beneficiaries.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA COMMERCE AND TRADE STATISTICS ACT, 2022.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Commerce and Trade Statistics Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a comprehensive system for collecting statistical data related to commerce and trade activities within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It creates a Statistical Authority empowered to collect information, maintain records, and conduct inspections of businesses to promote efficient market functioning.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA RESOLUTION OF COMMERCIAL DISPUTES ACT, 2022.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Resolution of Commercial Disputes Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Commercial Courts in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province to resolve commercial disputes expeditiously. It provides for the application of the Code of Civil Procedure, defines various entities including domestic and foreign companies, and outlines mechanisms for out-of-court settlements through Alternative Dispute Resolution.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA REGULARIZATION OF SERVICES OF EMPLOYEES OF DISTRICT GOVERNANCE AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT PROJECT ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Regularization of Services of Employees of District Governance and Community Development Project Act, 2022
subjects: District Governance and Community Development Project
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment and regularization of services for employees of the District Governance and Community Development Project in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It deems these employees to have been validly appointed on a regular basis upon the Act's commencement, subject to verification of their qualifications and credentials.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the supply of sugarcane and sugar beet to sugar factories within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes a Sugar-cane Control Board, defines key terms such as 'Factory' and 'Cane-grower', and outlines provisions for reserved areas, minimum pricing, and licensing of purchasing agents.

name: FOREST ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Forest Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the legal framework for the management, protection, and control of reserved, village, protected, guzara, and mazri forests in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It outlines powers to declare forest types, regulate timber transit and sale, impose duties and fees, and define penalties for offenses against forest resources.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA APPRENTICESHIP ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Apprenticeship Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the promotion, development, and regulation of systematic apprenticeship programmes in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province. It establishes minimum standards of skill, defines key terms such as 'apprentice' and 'employer', and outlines obligations for both parties regarding contracts, training, and termination.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION ACT, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Environmental Protection Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection, conservation, rehabilitation, and improvement of the environment in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It also establishes mechanisms for the prevention and control of pollution and promotes sustainable development within the province.

name: THE UPPER SWAT DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Upper Swat Development Authority Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Upper Swat Development Authority to develop the Upper Swat areas and other regions of District Swat. It defines the authority's composition, powers, functions, financial provisions, and outlines offences related to violations of construction rules or encroachment.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY AND HEALTH ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Occupational Safety and Health Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes provisions to ensure the occupational safety and health of all persons working in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It outlines specific duties for employers, workers, and other relevant parties while setting standards to protect against occupational hazards.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA HEALTHCARE FACILITIES MANAGEMENT ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Healthcare Facilities Management Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better management and administration of healthcare services and health facilities in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes Regional Authorities for Health within designated regions and districts to oversee these operations.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA FISHERIES AND AQUACULTURE ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Fisheries and Aquaculture Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection, preservation, conservation, regulation, and management of fisheries biodiversity and aquaculture in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes the Directorate General of Fisheries, defines key terms related to fish and water bodies, and outlines provisions for licensing, permits, offences, penalties, and trial procedures.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA (REGULARIZATION OF SERVICES OF EMPLOYEES OF ERSTWHILE FEDERALLY ADMINISTRATED TRIBAL AREAS) ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Regularization of Services of Employees of Erstwhile Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment and regularization of services of employees appointed on a contract basis against project posts in the erstwhile Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It deems these employees to have been validly appointed on a regular basis from the commencement of the Act, subject to verification of their qualifications.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA TEACHERS (APPOINTMENT AND REGULARIZATION OF SERVICES) ACT, 2022.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Teachers (Appointment and Regularization of Services) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment and regularization of services for teachers appointed on an ad-hoc or contract basis in the Elementary and Secondary Education Department of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It validates appointments made between March 8, 2017, and the commencement of this Act, provided specific conditions regarding qualifications and conduct are met.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA EMPLOYEES OF TRANSPORT DEPARTMENT (REGULARIZATION OF SERVICES) ACT, 2022.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Employees of Transport Department (Regularization of Services) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for contract and fixed pay basis employees appointed against project posts in the Transport Inspection Stations (TIS) and Peshawar Bus Terminal (PBT) within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Transport & Mass Transit Department. It deems these employees to have been validly appointed on a regular basis from the date of the Act's commencement, establishing their status as civil servants under the Directorate of Transport & Mass Transit.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA MEDICAL OFFICERS OF HEALTH DEPARTMENT (REGULARIZATION OF SERVICES) ACT, 2022.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Medical Officers of Health Department (Regularization of Services) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for Medical Officers appointed on a contract basis in the Health Department of the Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It deems these officers to have been validly appointed on a regular basis from the date of commencement, subject to verification of qualifications and credentials.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA SAFE BLOOD TRANSFUSION PROJECT (PHASE-II) EMPLOYEES (REGULARIZATION OF SERVICES) ACT, 2022.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Safe Blood Transfusion Project (Phase-II) Employees (Regularization of Services) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for employees appointed on a contract basis in the Safe Blood Transfusion Project (Phase-II) under the Health Department of the Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It deems these project employees to have been appointed on a regular basis from the date of the Act's commencement, subject to verification of their qualifications and credentials.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA FOOD FORTIFICATION ACT, 2022.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Food Fortification Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act mandates the fortification of staple food items like wheat flour, ghee, and edible oil to address severe micronutrient deficiencies in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes duties for importers, manufacturers, and commercial users regarding premix usage, labeling, and quality assurance while providing a framework for inspection and penalties.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA REVENUE AUTHORITY ACT, 2022.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Revenue Authority Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Revenue Authority as a body corporate to act as a tax collecting agency for the Government. It provides for the reformation of law relating to the establishment of the Authority and regulates matters concerning fiscal policies, administration, management, and the imposition and collection of taxes.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA FISCAL RESPONSIBILITY AND DEBT MANAGEMENT ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Fiscal Responsibility and Debt Management Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for sound fiscal risk management and public debt sustainability in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It defines key financial terms, sets principles for fiscal operations, and outlines authority and limitations regarding government borrowing and guarantees.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA INFRASTRUCTURE DEVELOPMENT CESS ACT, 2022.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy, collection, and administration of an infrastructure development cess on goods moving within or through the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The generated revenue is intended to fund the development, maintenance, and improvement of provincial infrastructure to handle increasing traffic loads.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA ABSORPTION OF CERTAIN EMPLOYEES ACT, 2021.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Absorption of Certain Employees Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the absorption of employees from Degree Colleges of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Education Foundation into the Directorate of Higher Education against permanent posts. It establishes general conditions for absorption, including qualification requirements and service continuity, while determining seniority relative to existing civil servants.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA FINANCE ACT, 2021.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2021
metadata.amends: Act No. II of 1899; Act No. XVI of 1908; West Pakistan Act No. V of 1958; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. IV of 1990; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. IV of 2000; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. XXIII of 2002; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XXI of 2013; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XXVIII of 2013
metadata.summary: This Act continues, revises, and exempts certain taxes and fees within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It amends several existing provincial acts and ordinances related to stamp duty, registration, urban immovable property tax, land tax, and finance.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA EXCISE DUTY ON MINERALS (LABOUR WELFARE) ACT, 2021.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Excise Duty on Minerals (Labour Welfare) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the imposition of excise duty on certain minerals within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. The revenue generated from this duty is intended to finance measures promoting the welfare of mine labourers.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA REGULARIZATION OF SERVICES IN ERSTWHILE FEDERALLY ADMINISTERED TRIBAL AREAS ACT, 2022.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Regularization of Services in Erstwhile Federally Administered Tribal Areas Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Regularization of Services in Erstwhile Federally Administered Tribal Areas Act, 2010; The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Regularization of Services in Erstwhile Federally Administered Tribal Areas Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment and regularization of services for certain employees appointed to projects in the erstwhile Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It deems these employees validly appointed on a regular basis from the commencement of the Act, subject to verification of their qualifications and credentials.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA LAND-USE AND BUILDING CONTROL ACT, 2021.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Land-Use and Building Control Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act regulates land-use and building control within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes councils, authorities, and local units to manage district plans, issue permissions, and enforce compliance with building regulations.

name: THE POWERS OF ATTORNEY ACT, 1882

metadata.title: The Powers of Attorney Act, 1882
metadata.repeals: Act XXVIII of 1866, s. 39
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to powers of attorney, defining the authority of donees and protecting third parties acting in good faith. It also establishes provisions for the deposit of original power-of-attorney instruments in High Courts and grants specific powers to married women to appoint attorneys.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA SCIENCE, TECHNOLOGY AND INNOVATION ENDOWMENT FUND ACT, 2022.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Science, Technology and Innovation Endowment Fund Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Science, Technology and Innovation Endowment Fund in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to promote indigenous capacity and address social, economic, and environmental challenges. It creates a Board with specific powers to manage the Fund, approve investments, and oversee research and innovation initiatives within the province.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DESERVING ARTISTS WELFARE ENDOWMENT FUND ACT, 2022.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Deserving Artists Welfare Endowment Fund Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Deserving Artists Welfare Endowment Fund to provide financial support to deserving artists in the province. The fund is intended to cover immediate health expenses, chronic disease treatments, and minimal livelihood requirements to ensure the dignity of artists. It also outlines the constitution and functions of a committee responsible for controlling and managing the fund.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA SENTENCING ACT, 2021.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Sentencing Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act lays down the factors that courts must consider when passing sentences to improve consistency in sentencing within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes a Sentencing Council and defines specific aggravating and mitigating factors, as well as the purposes of sentencing such as punishment, deterrence, and rehabilitation.

name: THE CITY UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY PESHAWAR ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The City University of Science and Information Technology (Peshawar), Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of the City University of Science and Information Technology at Peshawar in the private sector. It defines the university's structure, including its authorities, officers, and staff, while granting it perpetual succession and the power to acquire property.

name: Muqarraridars Conferment of Proprietary Rights Act, 1995.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Muqarraridars (Conferment of Proprietary Rights) Act, 1995
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Muqarraridars (Conferment of Proprietary Rights) Ordinance, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act confers full proprietary rights on persons entered as Muqarraridars in land owned or administered by the Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It stipulates that these individuals become full owners upon payment of compensation at prescribed rates and terms.

name: Ghulam Ishaq Khan (GIK) Institute of Engineering Sciences and Technology Act, 1994.

metadata.title: The Ghulam Ishaq Khan (GIK) Institute of Engineering Sciences and Technology Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Ghulam Ishaq Khan (GIK) Institute of Engineering Sciences and Technology at Topi in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It creates a body corporate with powers to provide engineering instruction, conduct research, and collaborate with national and international institutions.

name: Energy Development Organization Act, 1993.

metadata.title: The Pakhtunkhwa Energy Development Organization Act, 1993
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the development of power resources within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes the Pakhtunkhwa Energy Development Organization, defines its structure, powers, duties, and financial arrangements.

name: Finance Act, 1992.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1992
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; West Pakistan Finance Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and revises rates for certain taxes, duties, and fees within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It amends existing legislation including the Stamp Act of 1899, the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act of 1958, and the West Pakistan Finance Act of 1965 to update valuation tables and tax rates.

name: Bank of Khyber Act,1991

metadata.title: The Bank of Khyber Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Bank of Khyber in the province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to provide commercial and investment banking services. It aims to mobilize private savings, promote socio-economic processes, create employment opportunities, and assist people serving overseas by investing their foreign savings.

name: Subordinate Judiciary Service Tribunal Act, 1991

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Subordinate Judiciary Service Tribunal Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Service Tribunal for the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province to exercise exclusive jurisdiction over matters regarding the terms and conditions of service for members of the subordinate judiciary. It defines the constitution of the Tribunal, the powers of its benches, and the procedures for filing appeals against departmental orders.

name: Revision of Record-of-Rights Validation Act, 1991.

metadata.title: The Revision of Record-of-Rights (Validation) Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act validates the special revision of records-of-rights conducted in the districts of Bannu, Mardan, and Swabi. It deems these revisions valid despite non-publication of a specific notification or other legal objections.

name: Payment Of Dearness Allowances To Certain Employees Act, 1991.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Payment of Dearness Allowance to Certain Employees) Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of dearness allowances to certain employees in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It defines key terms such as 'employees', 'employer', and 'undertaking' to establish the scope of application.

name: Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act, 1990.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act, 1990
metadata.summary: This Act establishes and reconstitutes the Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It also amends and consolidates the existing laws relating to these boards.

name: Employees on Contract Basis (Regulation of Services) Act, 1989.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Employees on Contract Basis (Regulation of Services) Act, 1989
metadata.repeals: Section 5 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Civil Servants (Regularization of Services) Act, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the services of employees appointed on a contract basis within Government Departments of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It deems certain contract appointees as Civil Servants on an ad hoc basis and provides for the regularization of their services based on continuous officiation.

name: Repeal Of Martial Law Order Act, 1989.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Repeal of Martial Law Order) Act, 1989
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Order No. 362
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to repeal Martial Law Order No. 362, which was issued by the Martial Law Administrator for Zone 'B'. The legislation came into force immediately upon its enactment.

name: Enforcement Of Certain Provisions Of Law Act, 1989.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Enforcement of Certain Provisions of Law) Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act brings into force certain provisions of the Civil Procedure Code, 1908, and the Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887 within Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It mandates that these specific provisions and amendments come into effect immediately upon enactment.

name: Provincial Assembly (powers, Immunities And Privileges) Act, 1988

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Provincial Assembly (Powers, Immunities and Privileges) Act, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act defines the powers, immunities, and privileges of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Provincial Assembly, its Committees, and its Members. It establishes rules regarding attendance, legal protection for members, evidence procedures, publication of debates, and penalties for breaches of privilege.

name: THE MUNICIPAL TAXATION ACT, 1881

metadata.title: The Municipal Taxation Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Federal and Provincial Governments to prohibit the levy of municipal taxes on specific persons, such as military, naval, or air-force personnel and government officials. It establishes that when such prohibitions are in force, the respective governments must pay the tax amounts directly to the Municipal Committee instead.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN LAND PRESERVATION ACT, 1900

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Preservation Act, 1900
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better preservation and protection of certain portions of territories, specifically addressing erosion and sub-soil water conservation. It empowers the Provincial Government to notify areas, regulate restrictions within them, and award compensation for rights extinguished by these measures.

name: THE PRISONERS ACT, 1900

metadata.title: The Prisoners Act, 1900
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to prisoners confined by order of a Court. It defines terms such as 'Court' and 'Prison', outlines the duties of prison officers regarding detention and return of writs, and provides procedures for the execution of sentences and removal of prisoners.

name: THE HACKNEY-CARRIAGE ACT, 1879.

metadata.title: The Hackney-Carriage Act, 1879
metadata.repeals: The Hackney-Carriage Act, 1879 (vide A.O. 1937)
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and control of hackney carriages in certain municipalities and cantonments. It defines key terms such as 'hackney-carriage' and 'committee', empowers committees to make rules regarding licenses, fares, and vehicle conditions, and establishes penalties for breaches of these rules.

name: THE PUNJAB KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA GRAZING REGULATION, 1874

metadata.title: The Punjab Frontier Grazing Regulation, 1874
metadata.summary: This regulation governs the grazing of cattle, sheep, asses, and goats in specific districts of the Punjab frontier, including Bannu, Dera Ismail Khan, and Dera Ghazi Khan. It mandates that these animals must be accompanied by an armed guard when grazing west of the frontier military road or on adjoining village lands in Marwat District. The document outlines procedures for seizing unaccompanied animals, levying fines and penalties on owners, and selling unclaimed animals to cover costs.

name: THE PUNJAB FRONTIER CROSSING REGULATION, 1873

metadata.title: The Punjab Frontier Crossing Regulation, 1873
metadata.summary: This regulation prohibits persons duly warned from passing out of British Territory across the Frontier of specific districts in Punjab without a passport or pass. It outlines penalties for disobedience, powers to order removal, and procedures for taking security from suspected offenders.

name: THE COURT FEES ACT, 1870

metadata.title: The Court-Fees Act, 1870
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for levying court fees on documents filed in High Courts, subordinate courts, and public offices across Pakistan. It defines appropriate governments for fee purposes, outlines procedures for fee computation and refunds, and sets rules regarding probates, letters of administration, and process fees.

name: THE [KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA] GOMAL ZAM PROJECT CONTROL AND PREVENTION OF SPECULATION IN LAND ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Gomal Zam Project (Control and Prevention of Speculation in Land) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance controls land alienation and prevents speculation within the Gomal Zam Project Area in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes restrictions on selling or transferring project land for a period of ten years, defines specific conditions under which such transfers are considered speculative, and grants the government powers to appoint collectors, revise valuations, and acquire land.

name: THE [KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA] UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY (PESHAWAR) ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The University of Science and Information Technology (Peshawar) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of the University of Science and Information Technology in Peshawar within the private sector. It outlines the university's structure, including its authorities, officers, and governing bodies such as the Board of Governors and Academic Council.

name: THE QURTABA UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY D.I. KHAN ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: Qurtaba University of Science and Information Technology Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment and incorporation of the Qurtaba University of Science and Information Technology in Dera Ismail Khan. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its authorities, officers, and functions.

name: THE UNIVERSITY OF MALAKAND REGULATION, 2001

metadata.title: The University of Malakand Regulation, 2001
metadata.summary: This regulation provides for the establishment and incorporation of the University of Malakand, with its principal seat at Chakdara. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its powers to acquire property and sue or be sued.

name: THE KOHAT UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: Kohat University of Science and Technology Ordinance 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Kohat University of Science and Technology at Kohat as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the powers, functions, and structure of the university, including its officers, authorities, and governing bodies such as the Syndicate and Academic Council.

name: THE [KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA] FINANCE ORDINANCE, 2000

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 2000
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; West Pakistan Finance Act, 1965; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1965 (as amended by various Acts of 1995 and 1996)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance abolishes and modifies certain taxes, fees, and duties in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It amends existing legislation regarding stamp duties, urban immovable property tax, motor vehicle taxation, and finance acts to update rates and delete specific sections.

name: Finance Act, 1999.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1999
metadata.repeals: W.P. Act XXXVIII of 1958
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and revises rates for certain taxes, duties, and fees in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It specifically addresses fee enhancements for motor vehicles, registration requirements for private educational institutions, and amendments to existing provincial acts regarding stamp duties and urban immovable property tax.

name: Finance Act, 1998.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1998
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and revises rates for certain taxes, duties, and fees in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It amends existing legislation including the Stamp Act of 1899 and the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act of 1958 to update tax rates and definitions.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA WITNESS PROTECTION ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Witness Protection Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Witness Protection Board and a Witness Protection Unit within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to safeguard witnesses and other persons involved in sensitive criminal cases. It provides for various protective measures, including relocation, identity changes, close protection services, and special court procedures for terrorism or heinous offence cases.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Centre of Excellence on Countering Violent Extremism Act, 2021

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Centre of Excellence on Countering Violent Extremism Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a research-based Centre of Excellence in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa dedicated to countering violent extremism. It provides for the constitution of a Board of Governors, defines the powers and functions of the Centre, and outlines the appointment of officers and financial management.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA PROBATION AND PAROLE ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Probation and Parole Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the probation of convicts and their conditional release from prison before completing their sentence. It also covers matters related to parole, rehabilitation, and reintegration to help convicts become law-abiding citizens.

name: THE FEDERALLY ADMINISTERED TRIBAL AREAS DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY REGULATION (REPEAL) ACT, 2020.

metadata.title: The Federally Administered Tribal Areas Development Authority Regulation (Repeal) Act, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Federally Administered Tribal Areas Development Authority Regulation, 2006; The Federally Administered Tribal Areas Development Authority Regulation (Repeal) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Federally Administered Tribal Areas Development Authority Regulation, 2006, and consequently dissolves the Authority. It outlines the transfer of assets and liabilities to government departments and addresses the status of employees upon dissolution.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA EHTESAB COMMISSION (REPEAL) ACT, 2018.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ehtesab Commission (Repeal) Act, 2018
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ehtesab Commission Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ehtesab Commission Act, 2014 and dissolves the Ehtesab Commission established under it. It provides for the transfer of all assets, liabilities, records, and pending inquiries to the Anti-Corruption Establishment and outlines the status options for the commission's employees.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA HOME BASED WORKERS (WELFARE AND PROTECTION) ACT, 2021.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Home Based Workers (Welfare and Protection) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection and welfare of home based workers within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It regulates their working conditions, terms of employment, and defines the rights and duties of both employers and workers.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA TOURISM ACT, 2019.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Tourism Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework to promote culture and sustainable tourism in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It creates institutions such as the Provincial Tourism Strategy Board and the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Culture and Tourism Authority, while also providing for licensing, levies, and penalties.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA YOUTH AFFAIRS MANAGEMENT AND DISPOSAL OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTIES ACT, 2019.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Youth Affairs Management and Disposal of Immovable Properties Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the management and disposal of immovable properties belonging to the youth affairs department in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes a specific fund, creates a Management Committee to oversee these assets, and outlines procedures for leasing, maintenance, and financial administration.

name: The Essential Personnel (Registration) Ordinance, 1948

metadata.title: The Essential Personnel (Registration) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the compulsory registration of essential personnel at Employment Exchanges established by the Government of Pakistan. It defines essential personnel, outlines liability to register for individuals and employers, and establishes procedures for obtaining registration certificates.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA REGISTRATION OF GODOWNS ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Registration of Godowns Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration and regulation of godowns in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to ensure a stable supply of goods. It establishes a licensing system, outlines responsibilities for licensees regarding safety and hygiene, and prescribes penalties for non-compliance.

name: THE SPECIFIC RELIEF ACT, 1877

metadata.title: The Specific Relief Act, 1877
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to certain kinds of specific relief obtainable in civil suits. It covers topics such as recovering possession of property, specific performance of contracts, rectification of instruments, rescission, cancellation, and the granting of injunctions.

name: THE PAK-AUSTRIA FACHHOCHSCHULE INSTITUTE OF APPLIED SCIENCES AND TECHNOLOGY, HARIPUR BILL, 2019.

metadata.title: The Pak-Austria Fachhochschule Institute of Applied Sciences and Technology, Haripur Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pak-Austria Fachhochschule Institute of Applied Sciences and Technology, Haripur as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the Institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy to conduct teaching and research in engineering, sciences, and technology.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Education Employees Foundation Act, 2018.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Education Employees Foundation Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Education Employees Foundation as a body corporate to promote the welfare of education employees and their families. The Foundation is authorized to provide low-cost accommodation, scholarships for children, financial assistance during retirement or death, and marriage grants.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA CONTINUATION OF LAWS IN THE ERSTWHILE FEDERALLY ADMINISTERED TRIBAL AREAS ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Continuation of Laws in the Erstwhile Federally Administered Tribal Areas Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuation of laws, regulations, rules, and bye-laws applicable in the erstwhile Federally Administered Tribal Areas after their merger into the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It ensures that these legal instruments remain in force until altered, repealed, or amended by the competent authority, while validating actions taken under them prior to this Act.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA LEGAL AID ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Legal Aid Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Legal Aid Agency to provide legal services to indigent persons in the province. It outlines the functions of the agency, including policy evolution and fee structures, while defining key terms such as 'indigent person' and 'family dispute'. The legislation also sets forth procedures for applying for legal aid and the administration of the agency by a Director General.

name: THE PROTECTION AGAINST HARASSMENT OF WOMEN AT THE WORKPLACE ACT, 2010 (ACT NO. IV OF 2010)

metadata.title: The Protection against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal provisions to protect women from harassment at the workplace within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes mechanisms including an Inquiry Committee and an Ombudsperson to handle complaints, define key terms like 'harassment' and 'employer', and outline the responsibilities of organizations.

name: The Prisons Act, 1894

metadata.title: The Prisons Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the administration of prisons in Pakistan, covering preliminary provisions, maintenance, officer duties, and prisoner management. It establishes rules for admission, discipline, food supply, employment, health care, and penalties related to prison offenses.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Waqaf Properties Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the proper management and administration of waqf properties in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes the appointment of Chief Administrators and other officers, defines powers regarding leases, evictions, and property registration, and outlines procedures for appeals and offences.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Code of Civil Procedure (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 to introduce procedural reforms aimed at providing inexpensive and expeditious justice. It establishes new rules regarding court hierarchy, pecuniary jurisdiction, plaint filing requirements, written statements, and electronic records of proceedings within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA BOARD OF TECHNICAL AND COMMERCE EDUCATION ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Board of Technical and Commerce Education Act, 2021
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Board of Technical Education Act, 1972 (Act No. VI of 1973)
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Board of Technical Education into the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Board of Technical and Commerce Education. It establishes the board as a body corporate with powers to regulate, supervise, and assess students in technical, vocational, industrial, IT, and commerce institutes within the province.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA REPRODUCTIVE HEALTHCARE RIGHTS ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Reproductive Healthcare Rights Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides reproductive healthcare and promotes reproductive health rights within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes the functions of the Department to ensure non-discrimination, quality services, and public awareness regarding reproductive health.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA YOUTH WELFARE ENDOWMENT FUND ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Youth Welfare Endowment Fund Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Youth Welfare Endowment Fund to financially support and assist youth in the province. The Fund aims to help young people flourish their new business ideas and lead prosperous lives through small grants, sponsorships for conferences, and cash prizes.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA EMPLOYEES OF TRANSPORT AND MASS TRANSIT DEPARTMENT (REGULARIZATION OF SERVICES) ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Employees of Transport and Mass Transit Department (Regularization of Services) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment and regularization of services for Motor Vehicle Examiners appointed on an adhoc basis and certain employees of Vehicular Emission Testing Stations appointed on a fixed pay basis within the Directorate of Transport and Mass Transit in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It deems these employees to have been validly appointed on a regular basis from the date of the Act's commencement, subject to verification of qualifications.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA SPECIAL POLICE OFFICERS (REGULARIZATION OF SERVICES) ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Special Police Officers (Regularization of Services) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for Special Police Officers who were appointed on a contract or fixed pay basis. It establishes rules for determining seniority among regularized officers and creates a Scrutiny Committee to verify records before final approval.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA YOUTH DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Youth Development Commission Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Youth Development Commission to provide vision, directions, and an institutional roadmap for youth empowerment. It defines the commission's composition, meeting procedures, and powers to monitor strategies in the social, economic, and political spheres of the province.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA CONTINUATION OF LAWS IN THE ERSTWHILE PROVINCIALLY ADMINISTERED TRIBAL AREAS ACT, 2018

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Continuation of Laws in the Erstwhile Provincially Administered Tribal Areas Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuation of laws in the erstwhile Provincially Administered Tribal Areas merged into the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It ensures that existing regulations, rules, and bye-laws applicable to these areas remain in force until altered by the competent authority.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA PUBLIC PRIVATE PARTNERSHIP ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Private Partnership Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the participation of the private sector in public sector projects within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa through Public Private Partnerships. It establishes institutional arrangements, including a Committee and various units, to facilitate socio-economic and infrastructure development by encouraging private sector involvement.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DOMESTIC VIOLENCE AGAINST WOMEN (PREVENTION AND PROTECTION) ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Domestic Violence against Women (Prevention and Protection) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act is enacted by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to curb domestic violence against women in the province. It establishes District Protection Committees, defines various forms of abuse including economic and psychological harm, and provides for interim orders, monetary relief, and imprisonment for offenders.

name: THE PAKHTUNKHWA ENERGY DEVELOPMENT ORGANIZATION ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Pakhtunkhwa Energy Development Organization Act, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Pakhtunkhwa Energy Development Organization Act, 1993
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the sustainable and green development of power resources within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It re-organizes the existing Pakhtunkhwa Energy Development Organization (PEDO) to facilitate private sector investment and corporatize power sector entities.

name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act 2019

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act is enacted to protect and secure the ownership and possession rights of women in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes an Ombudsperson with specific powers to investigate complaints regarding property deprivation caused by harassment, coercion, force, or fraud, and to order the restoration of title and possession.

name: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Laws) Regulation. 1976

metadata.title: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1976
metadata.summary: This regulation applies specific existing laws to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Chitral, Dir, Kalam, Swat, and Malakand Protected Area. It establishes procedures for tax recovery, defines government authority, and stipulates that certain previous laws in those areas cease to operate upon its commencement.

name: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1975

metadata.title: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1976
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1960 (W. P. Ord. No. XIII of 1960)
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies specific laws to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Chitral, Dir, Kalam, Swat, and Malakand Protected Area. It establishes the authority for tax recovery, defines government powers, and repeals existing local laws that correspond to the newly applied regulations.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Validation of Orders and Actions of the Court of Wards) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Validation of Orders and Actions of the Court of Wards) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain orders made by the Commissioner of Peshawar Division and actions taken under the Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903 as applicable to Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It deems these specific orders regarding property supervision and expenditure incurred between 1955 and 1970 to have been validly made and done.

name: Bus Stand and Traffic Control (Peshawar) Ordinance, 1975

metadata.title: The Bus Stand and Traffic Control (Peshawar) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures to remove and prevent traffic congestion within the Municipal Committee, Peshawar. It regulates the movement of vehicular traffic and establishes provisions for bus stands, including their maintenance, shifting of existing stands, and penalties for contravention.

name: Standard Weights and measures enforcement Act, 1976.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Standard Weights and Measures Enforcement Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the enforcement of standard weights and measures in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and related matters. It establishes definitions, standards, verification processes, licensing requirements, and penalties for violations regarding commercial weights and measures.

name: The west Pakistan Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on possession and use) Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Repeal Act, 1974.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Repeal) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: West Pakistan Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) Ordinance, 1966; West Pakistan Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Repeal) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the West Pakistan Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) Ordinance, 1966, as it applied to Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It also repeals the earlier Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. VI of 1974 regarding the same subject matter.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Minister (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act determines the salaries, allowances, and privileges for Ministers in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes specific rates for the Chief Minister and other Ministers, outlines entitlements for travel expenses, official cars, and medical facilities, and defines terms such as 'family' and 'official residence'.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNHWA POWER CRUSHERS (LICENSING) ORDINANCE, 1980

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Power Crushers (Licensing) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the licensing and registration of power crushers used for crushing sugarcane in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes a licensing authority, outlines application procedures, and sets fees and penalties for non-compliance.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA (PROVINCIAL URBAN DEVELOPMENT BOARD VALIDATION OF ACTIONS) ORDINANCE, 1980

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Provincial Urban Development Board Validation of Actions) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain actions taken by officers of the Provincial Urban Development Board in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It declares a specific area as an urban area and deems previous notifications and appointments to have been valid under the relevant Urban Planning Ordinance, 1978.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA (CONSERVATION AND EXPLOITATION OF CERTAIN FORESTS IN HAZARA DIVISION) ORDINANCE, 1980

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Conservation and Exploitation of Certain Forests in Hazara Division) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the conservation and better exploitation of forests in specific areas of the Hazara Division. It prohibits private extraction of timber and other forest produce, mandates government control over such activities, and outlines procedures for the disposal of uncollected timber through public auction.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA FOREST DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION ORDINANCE, 1980

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Forest Development Corporation Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the establishment of the Forest Development Corporation in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It provides for the incorporation, administration, and functions of the Corporation, including the constitution of its Board and management structure.

name: THE SUITS VALUATION ACT,1887

metadata.title: The Suits Valuation Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act prescribes the mode of valuing certain suits to determine the jurisdiction of courts. It specifically addresses suits relating to land and establishes that the relief sought in such suits shall not exceed the determined value of the land.

name: THE PUNJAB FRONTIER POLICE-OFFICERS REGULATION, 1893

metadata.title: The Punjab Frontier Police-Officers Regulation, 1893
metadata.summary: This Regulation authorizes the Lieutenant-Governor of Punjab to confer magisterial powers on Assistant District Superintendents of Police in specific districts. It validates past exercises of authority by these officers that were not strictly prescribed by earlier Acts, ensuring their actions are not deemed illegal.

name: THE REVENUE RECOVERY ACT, 1890

metadata.title: The Revenue Recovery Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act provides better provisions for recovering certain public demands, specifically focusing on land-revenue arrears. It outlines the procedures for Collectors to enforce recovery processes in districts other than where the demand originated and defines the remedies available to persons denying liability.

name: THE PUNJAB ALIENATION OF LAND ACT, 1900

metadata.title: The Punjab Alienation of Land Act, 1900
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to agricultural land in the Punjab, specifically regulating permanent and temporary alienations. It establishes requirements for sanctions by the Deputy Commissioner for certain land transfers and restricts forms of mortgages and leases.

name: Suppression of Crimes Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Suppression of Crimes Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Villages and Small Towns Patrol and Protection Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to deal more effectively with offences against life and property in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes provisions for imposing fines on inhabitants accessory to serious crimes, outlines appeal procedures, and grants immunity for actions taken in good faith under the law.

name: Land Revenue (Re-Imposition) Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Land Revenue (Re-imposition) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Land Revenue (Abolition) Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance re-imposes land revenue for the Rabi 1976-77 and Kharif 1977 seasons in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It mandates that owners of irrigated or un-irrigated land exceeding specific acreage limits must pay double the rate applicable before the Land Revenue (Abolition) Act, 1977 came into force.

name: Finance Act, 1977

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1977
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes, cesses, and surcharges in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes specific rates for cinema tax, enhances fees relating to motor vehicles, and amends existing West Pakistan Acts regarding immovable property and finance.

name: Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Act, 1977

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides measures for the removal of encroachments from public property and addresses ancillary matters. It establishes a Tribunal to handle cases regarding unauthorized occupancy, eviction, and the recovery of costs associated with demolition.

name: Finance Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1975
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Entertainment Duty Act, 1958; West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes, cesses, and surcharges in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes specific rates for agricultural income-tax surcharges, cinema tax, motor vehicle tax, and fees related to opium and poppy heads.

name: Finance Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes, cesses, and surcharges in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes specific rates for agricultural income-tax surcharges, cinema taxes, and motor vehicle tax surcharges for the financial year 1976-77.

name: Khyber Medical College And Hayat Shaheed Teaching Hospital (Taking Over) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Khyber Medical College and Hayat Shaheed Teaching Hospital (Taking Over) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the taking over of Khyber Medical College and Hayat Shaheed Teaching Hospital by the Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It details the transfer of assets, liabilities, and employees from the college to the government while establishing a committee to settle related rights and obligations.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ehtram-e- Ramazan (Repeal) Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: The Ehtram-e-Ramazan (Repeal) Ordinance, 1981
