metadata.repeals: The Ehtram-e-Ramazan Act, 1972 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act I of 1973)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to repeal the Ehtram-e-Ramazan Act, 1972. It extends to the whole of the province and came into force immediately upon enactment.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Water Users' Associations Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Water Users' Associations Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the formation, operation, and promotion of water users' associations in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes these associations as bodies corporate with specific powers regarding dues recovery, dispute resolution, and land management.

name: The Land Acquisition Act, 1894

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law regarding the acquisition of land needed for public purposes and for companies. It also establishes the procedures for determining the amount of compensation to be paid upon such acquisition.

name: Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides legal measures to prevent gambling within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It defines various forms of gaming and establishes penalties for owning common gaming houses, participating in games in public or private places, and other related offenses.

name: Court Fees (Abolition) Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: The Court Fees (Abolition) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance abolishes the requirement to pay court fees in specific criminal and low-value civil cases within Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It also establishes provisions for refunding fees paid after the ordinance's commencement and allows courts to impose punitive double fees for frivolous or vexatious claims.

name: Corporation Employees (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Corporation Employees (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance invests the Governor of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa with special powers regarding persons in Corporation service. It allows for the removal or reversion of specific employees without notice and establishes procedures for representation and review.

name: Bus stand and Traffic Control (Peshawar) Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Bus Stand and Traffic Control (Peshawar) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures to remove and prevent traffic congestion within the Municipal Committee, Peshawar. It regulates the movement of vehicular traffic and establishes rules for bus stands, including their provision, maintenance, and shifting from unauthorized locations.

name: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Specific Relief Act) Regulation, 1976

metadata.title: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Specific Relief Act) Regulation, 1976
metadata.summary: This regulation applies the Specific Relief Act, 1877 to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Chitral, Dir, Kalam, Swat, and Malakand Protected Areas. It also stipulates that any existing laws or customs corresponding to the provisions of the said Act in those areas shall cease to have effect upon its commencement.

name: KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA MINES SAFETY INSPECTION AND REGULATION ACT, 2020

metadata.title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Mines Safety Inspection and Regulation Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to mine safety, mining operations, and the inspection and regulation of mines. It establishes provisions for inspectors, mining boards, health standards, employment hours, maternity benefits, and penalties for contraventions.

name: KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA HEALTHCARE SERVICE PROVIDERS AND FACILITIES (PREVENTION OF VIOLENCE AND DAMAGE TO PROPERTY) ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Healthcare Service Providers and Facilities (Prevention of Violence and Damage to Property) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits violence against healthcare service providers, patients, and their attendants within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It also aims to prevent damage or loss to property in healthcare service facilities to ensure uninterrupted provision of healthcare services.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA ALTERNATE DISPUTE RESOLUTION ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Alternate Dispute Resolution Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a system for alternate dispute resolution in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to facilitate the settlement of disputes without formal litigation. It provides mechanisms for courts and designated officers to refer civil and criminal cases to processes such as negotiation, mediation, and conciliation.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA REHABILITATION OF MINORITIES (VICTIMS OF TERRORISM) ENDOWMENT FUND ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Rehabilitation of Minorities (Victims of Terrorism) Endowment Fund Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Endowment Fund to provide financial support, treatment, welfare, and rehabilitation for minority victims of terrorism and their family members. It outlines the constitution, functions, and management of a specific Committee responsible for assessing applications and administering the fund.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa School Bags (Limitation of Weight) Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa School Bags (Limitation of Weight) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act regulates and fixes the average weight of school bags for students in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It assigns enforcement responsibilities to relevant educational departments and authorities while establishing penalties for non-compliance.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils (Repeal) Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils (Repeal) Act, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act, 2015. It was enacted because the Election Commission of Pakistan has been empowered to delimit councils under the Elections Act, 2017, rendering the 2015 Act redundant.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Urban Areas Development Authorities Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Urban Areas Development Authorities Act, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. XIII of 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and establishment of Urban Areas Development Authorities in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It re-establishes local development authorities previously dissolved under a 2002 ordinance to manage urban areas with greater autonomy.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Trust Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Trust Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for the creation, administration, and extinction of trusts within Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It defines the rights and duties of trustees and beneficiaries, outlines registration procedures, and addresses obligations in the nature of trusts.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA GOVERNMENT REST HOUSES AND TOURISM PROPERTIES (DEVELOPMENT, MANAGEMENT AND REGULATION) ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Government Rest Houses and Tourism Properties (Development, Management and Regulation) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for developing, managing, and regulating Government Rest Houses and Tourism Properties in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It transfers ownership and administrative control of these properties to specific government departments to ensure transparent and efficient operations.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA FORENSIC SCIENCE AGENCY ACT, 2020.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Forensic Science Agency Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Forensic Science Agency within the province to conduct forensic examinations and render expert opinions for courts and tribunals. It outlines the agency's functions, including operating laboratories, maintaining records, and training personnel in forensic techniques.

name: COVID-19 (Prevention of Hoarding) Act, 2020 (Act No. XLI of 2020)

metadata.title: COVID-19 (Prevention of Hoarding) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of hoarding of scheduled articles during the emergent situation caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. It defines offences related to hoarding, grants powers to officers for search and seizure without a warrant, and establishes penalties including imprisonment and fines.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Health (Surveillance and Response) Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Health (Surveillance and Response) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the implementation and enforcement of measures to prevent and control diseases in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province. It establishes a disease surveillance system from the grassroots level to the provincial level, including the creation of a Provincial Public Health Committee and Disease Surveillance Centers.

name: Federal National Disaster Management Act, 2010

metadata.title: The National Disaster Management Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a comprehensive National Disaster Management System for Pakistan, including the creation of a National Commission and Provincial Authorities. It defines key terms such as 'disaster' and outlines the functions, powers, and responsibilities of various government bodies involved in preparedness, response, recovery, and reconstruction.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2020
metadata.amends: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. II of 1899; West Pakistan Act No. V of 1958; West Pakistan Act No. XXXII of 1958; West Pakistan Ordinance No. XIX of 1965; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. VIII of 1983; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. IV of 1990; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. XXIII 2002; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. VIII of 2010; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XXI of 2013
metadata.summary: This Act continues, revises, and exempts certain taxes and fees within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It amends various existing laws related to stamp duty, urban immovable property tax, motor vehicles taxation, and other provincial ordinances to update rates, deadlines, and rebate structures.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act 2019

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1990; The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1995; The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1996; The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Land Tax and Agriculture Income Tax Ordinance, 2000; The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 2002; The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2010; The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy, continuation, revision, and exemption of certain taxes, fees, cess, and duties in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It amends several existing finance acts from 1990 to 2013 and substitutes schedules or tables in related ordinances and acts.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA EPIDEMIC CONTROL AND EMERGENCY RELIEF ACT, 2020 (KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA ACT NO. XXVII OF 2020)

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Epidemic Control and Emergency Relief Act, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ord. No. XI of 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention and control of infectious diseases within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It also establishes mechanisms to provide relief to people during emergency situations arising from such outbreaks.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA WATER ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Water Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act comprehensively manages and regulates water resources in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province to ensure conservation and sustainability. It establishes specific commissions and authorities, defines duties for service providers regarding water supply and sewerage, and sets out provisions for charging, abstraction approvals, and environmental protection.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 2019

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the control of narcotic, narcotic drug, and psychotropic substances within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to eliminate their evils. It establishes prohibitions on cultivation, trafficking, and possession, while also creating special courts and mechanisms for asset freezing and forfeiture.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Panahgah Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Panahgah Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Panahgah Welfare Board to provide night stay facilities for shelterless people with comfort and dignity. It defines the composition, powers, and functions of the Board, as well as the establishment of a welfare fund and rules regarding privileges for shelterless individuals.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Vagrancy Restraint Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Vagrancy Restraint Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the care, rehabilitation, and reintegration of vagrants in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes a Steering Committee and Dar-ul-Kafala institutions to manage these matters while defining powers for police officers and penalties for employing persons to ask for alms.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Civil Administration (Public Service Delivery and Good Governance) Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Civil Administration (Public Service Delivery and Good Governance) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an effective system of civil administration to ensure good governance and improved service delivery within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It creates mechanisms for performance management, enforcement of regulatory regimes, and robust grievance redressal systems involving various administrative officers.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Power Crushers (Installation, Operation and Regulation) Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Power Crushers (Installation, Operation and Regulation) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the installation and operation of power crushers used for cutting, refining, crushing, grinding stones, minerals, and rocks in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes a licensing system managed by the Licensing Authority, mandates safe distances from sensitive locations like schools and hospitals, and outlines penalties for non-compliance.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Promotion, Protection and Enforcement of Human Rights Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Promotion, Protection and Enforcement of Human Rights Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Directorate General of Law and Human Rights in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province to promote, protect, and enforce human rights. It defines key terms such as 'aggrieved person' and 'Non-Governmental Organization', and outlines the powers and functions of the Directorate, including conducting inquiries into human rights violations.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Code of Civil Procedure (Amendment) Act, 2019

metadata.title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Code of Civil Procedure (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 to introduce procedural reforms aimed at providing inexpensive and expeditious justice. It inserts new sections regarding primary objectives, substitutes existing sections on court hierarchy and pecuniary jurisdiction, and mandates electronic records for proceedings.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Regional and District Health Authorities Act, 2019

metadata.title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Regional and District Health Authorities Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a comprehensive and efficient healthcare system in the province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by reorganizing existing health facilities. It creates Regional Health Authorities at the divisional level and a Policy Board to determine standards, recommend policies, and oversee management and training for these authorities.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Khasadar Force Act, 2019

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Khasadar Force Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal status to the Khasadar Force, which previously operated in the erstwhile Federally Administered Tribal Areas following their merger into the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It regulates the re-constitution, administration, control, and recruitment methods for the force to ensure better public order and security in the merged districts.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Levies Force Act, 2019

metadata.title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Levies Force Act, 2019
metadata.repeals: Federal Levies Force Regulation, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the maintenance of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Levies Force following the merger of the Federally Administered Tribal Areas into the province. It enables the transition of the force from federal to provincial administrative control under the Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

name: The National Disaster Management (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa)(Amendment) Act, 2019

metadata.title: National Disaster Management (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa) (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: National Disaster Management Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the National Disaster Management Act, 2010 to insert provisions for declaring a state of emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It also adds a new section regarding the repeal and saving of the West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA CHARITIES ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Charities Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration and regulation of charities and the collection of charitable funds within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province. It establishes a Commission to oversee these activities, defines various terms related to charity trustees and promoters, and outlines procedures for registration, audits, and penalties for offenses.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Educational Monitoring Authority Act, 2019

metadata.title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Education Monitoring Authority Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Education Monitoring Authority to oversee elementary and secondary education in the public sector of the province. The Authority is tasked with strengthening accountability, promoting transparency, ensuring value for money, and improving the performance of educational entities through monitoring and reporting.

name: The West Pakistan Co-operative Board (Dissolution) Act, 1966.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Co-operative Board (Dissolution) Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the dissolution of the West Pakistan Co-operative Board and the vacation of offices by its Chairman and members. It establishes an Administrator to wind up the Board's affairs, recover assets, pay liabilities, and administer remaining projects and funds under Government control.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Timber Market (Peshawar) Ordinance, 1972.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Timber Market (Peshawar) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of a timber market in the revenue estate of village Achar within Peshawar. It outlines the powers of the Peshawar Improvement Trust to acquire land, allot sites to merchants, and regulate business operations while defining penalties for contravention.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Text Book Board Ordinance, 1971.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Text Book Board Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Text Book Board as a body corporate to manage educational materials. It provides for the production and publication of textbooks, supplementary reading material, and guide books for teachers within the province.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PUBLICATION OF TEXTBOOKS (REGULATION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: West Pakistan Publication of Textbooks (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation and control of the printing, publication, and sale of textbooks published by or under the authority of the West Pakistan Textbook Board. It establishes prohibitions on unauthorized printing or selling, defines offenses with penalties including imprisonment or fines, and outlines procedures for forfeiture and legal cognizance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PRIVATE COLLEGES (MANAGEMENT AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: West Pakistan Private Colleges (Management and Control) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the control and management of private colleges in West Pakistan. It establishes a Governing Body for each college to streamline administration and regulate service conditions for teachers.

name: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1974

metadata.title: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1974
metadata.summary: This regulation applies specific laws to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Chitral, Dir, Kalam, Swat, and Malakand Protected Area. It outlines the authority for tax recovery, defines government powers, and specifies which previous laws cease to operate upon its commencement.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Speaker and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Speaker and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries, allowances, and privileges of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Provincial Assembly. It establishes specific rates for salary, various travel allowances, official residence benefits, and medical facilities.

name: The Provincially Administrated Tribal Areas (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1974

metadata.title: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Laws) (Second) Regulation, 1974
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies specific laws to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Chitral, Dir, Kalam, Swat, and Malakand Protected Area. It outlines the authority for tax recovery, defines government powers, and specifies which existing laws cease to operate in these areas upon commencement.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission Act, 1973 with certain modifications. It establishes the composition of the Commission, defines the terms of office for members, and outlines the appointment process.

name: Provincial Assembly of the Khyber Pakthunkhwa (Salaries and Allowances of Members) Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Salaries and Allowances of Members) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to the salaries and allowances of Members of the Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes specific rates for salary, sumptuary allowance, and various other allowances while defining terms such as 'Member', 'session', and 'period of residence on duty'.

name: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Probation of Offenders Ordinance) Regulation, 1981

metadata.title: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Probation of Offenders Ordinance) Regulation, 1981
metadata.repeals: Any law, instrument, custom or usage having the force of law corresponding to the provisions of the Probation of Offenders Ordinance, 1960 in force in the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas
metadata.summary: This regulation applies the Probation of Offenders Ordinance, 1960 to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of the North-West Frontier Province. It also stipulates that any existing laws, instruments, customs, or usages corresponding to the provisions of the said Ordinance shall cease to have effect upon the commencement of this regulation.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1996

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1996
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. IV of 1949; West Pakistan Act X of 1958; West Pakistan Act XXXII of 1958; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance IX of 1980; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act I of 1994; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act I of 1995
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy, revision, and modification of certain taxes, cesses, duties, and fees in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It amends several existing laws, including the Stamp Act of 1899 and various provincial acts from 1949 to 1995.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA) FINANCE ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan [Khyber Pakhtunkhwa] Finance Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues and levies certain taxes, cesses, and surcharges in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (formerly West Pakistan). It establishes specific rates for agricultural income-tax surcharges, cinema tax, motor vehicle tax surcharges, and railway fare taxes for the financial year 1970-71.

name: WEST PAKISTAN LOCAL COUNCILS HIGH SCHOOLS (TAKING OVER) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: West Pakistan Local Councils High Schools (Taking Over) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the taking over of High Schools maintained by District Councils and Town Committees in West Pakistan by the Government. It details the transfer of staff, assets, and funds from local councils to the government while preserving liabilities accrued up to the date of enforcement.

name: Finance Act, 1978

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues and levies certain taxes, cesses, and surcharges in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958 to introduce rebates for lump-sum tax payments and adjust penalties for defaults.

name: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1967

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1967
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes and duties in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes surcharges on agricultural income-tax, cinema taxes, motor vehicle taxes, and railway fare taxes for specific financial years.

name: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1966.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies various taxes and duties in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes specific surcharges on agricultural income-tax, taxes on cinemas and motor vehicles, and tolls on inland vessels and railway fares for the financial year 1966-67.

name: The Reformatory Schools Act, 1897

metadata.title: The Reformatory Schools Act, 1897
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to Reformatory Schools and provides further provisions for dealing with youthful offenders. It establishes the framework for creating, managing, and inspecting these schools while defining the rights and treatment of boys under fifteen convicted of offenses.

name: Land Improvement Loans Act, 1883

metadata.title: The Land Improvement Loans Act, 1883
metadata.amends: The Land Improvement Act, 1871
metadata.repeals: The Land Improvement Act, 1871; Act XXI of 1876
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to government loans for agricultural improvements. It defines eligible purposes for loans, such as constructing wells, draining land, and reclaiming wasteland, while repealing earlier acts from 1871 and 1876.

name: THE CANAL AND DRAINAGE ACT, 1873

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage Act, 1873
metadata.summary: This Act regulates irrigation, navigation, and drainage within the territories to which it extends. It establishes powers for canal officers regarding water supply, compensation for damages, and the construction of works.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Property Acquisition (Repeal) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Property Acquisition (Repeal) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Property Acquisition Ordinance, 1972 (Ord. No. XXII of 1972)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to immediately repeal the Property Acquisition Ordinance, 1972. It was issued under the powers of the Interim Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1972

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1972
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Act X of 1958; West Pakistan Act V of 1958; West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965; West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Rules, 1969; West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; West Pakistan Finance Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes, cesses, and surcharges in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa region. It establishes specific rates for agricultural income tax surcharges, cinema taxes, motor vehicle taxes, and electricity duties for the financial year 1972-73.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 1971
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Act V of 1958; West Pakistan Act XXXIV of 1964; Opium Act, 1878; Agricultural Income tax Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues and levies certain taxes, cesses, and surcharges in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes specific rates for cinema tax and motor vehicle surcharges while amending existing urban immovable property and finance acts applicable to the region.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Villages and Small Towns Patrol and Protection) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Villages and Small Towns Patrol and Protection) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the performance of nightly patrol duties by inhabitants to ensure peace and tranquility in villages and towns. It establishes the powers of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate to issue orders, appoint councils, and select patrol members while defining related terms and penalties.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Benevolent Fund to provide relief for Government servants and their families in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It outlines the constitution of the fund, its sources of income, utilization for financial assistance, and provisions for account audit.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Government Education and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Government Education and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Boards of Governors for government educational and training institutions in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to ensure their efficient management and control. It defines the composition, powers, and procedures of these boards, including the appointment of members by the Chief Minister and the roles of the Chairman and Secretary.

name: THE CANAL AND DRAINAGE ACT, 1873 (EXTENSION TO III LORA CANAL OF BANNU DISTRICT) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage Act, (Extension to III Lora Canal of Bannu District) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.number: W. P. Ord No. XLIII OF 1969
metadata.amends: The Canal and Drainage Act, 1873
metadata.repeals: Punjab Minor Canals Act, 1905
metadata.summary: This Ordinance applies the provisions of the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 to the III Lora Canal in Bannu District. It also validates the levy of occupier's rates for areas irrigated by this canal and ensures previous notifications regarding these rates remain valid.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN PRIVY PURSES (CHARGED EXPENDITURE) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Privy Purses (Charged Expenditure) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance declares that payments made by the Central Government as privy purses to rulers of former states incorporated into West Pakistan are a charge on the provincial Consolidated Fund. It further stipulates that any such sums reimbursed to the Central Government before this Ordinance came into force shall be deemed to have been charged and paid under it.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN RAILWAY SERVANTS BENEVOLENT FUND ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Railway Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Benevolent Fund to provide relief for Railway servants and their families in West Pakistan. It outlines the constitution of the fund, its division into parts for gazetted and non-gazetted servants, methods of contribution, utilization for financial assistance, and the establishment of management committees.

name: The West Pakistan Cotton Control (Validation of Levy of Fees) Ordinance, 1966.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Cotton Control Validation of Levy of Fees Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The West Punjab Cotton (Control) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the levy, charging, collection, and realization of fees from occupiers of cotton ginning, pressing, seed oil factories, dealers, and company managers for specific periods between 1949 and 1964. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under Article 79 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA EMPLOYEES OF THE ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY EDUCATION DEPARTMENT (APPOINTMENT AND REGULARIZATION OF SERVICES) ACT, 2017 (Amendments)

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Employees of the Elementary & Secondary Education Department (Appointment and Regularization of Services) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment and regularization of services for certain employees in the Elementary and Secondary Education Department of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa who were appointed on an adhoc, contract basis, or through specific projects. It deems these eligible employees to have been validly appointed on a regular basis from their initial appointment date, subject to meeting qualification requirements and not having resigned due to misconduct.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA CENSORSHIP OF MOTION PICTURES (FILMS, CDS, VIDEOS, STAGE DRAMAS AND SHOWS) ACT, 2018

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Censorship of Motion Pictures (Films, CDs, Videos, Stage Dramas and Shows) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the censorship and regulation of films, CDs, videos, stage dramas, and shows intended for public exhibition via cinematographs, cable networks, or electronic media. It establishes a Board to examine and certify these materials, setting out principles for certification, procedures for appeals, penalties for unauthorized exhibition, and powers to suspend or direct exhibitions.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA EMPLOYEES (REGULARIZATION OF SERVICES) ACT, 2018

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Employees (Regularization of Services) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment and regularization of services for certain employees appointed on an adhoc basis against civil posts and on a contract basis against project posts in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It deems these employees to have been validly appointed on a regular basis from the date of the Act's commencement, subject to verification of qualifications.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA MARRIAGE FUNCTIONS (PROHIBITION OF OSTENTATIOUS DISPLAYS AND WASTEFUL EXPENSES) ACT, 2018

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a regulatory system for marriage functions within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province to curb wasteful spending and ostentatious displays. It imposes specific limits on bridal gifts, restricts loudspeaker usage and fireworks, sets a maximum time limit for ceremonies at 11:00 PM, and outlines penalties for non-compliance.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA PROVINCIAL BUILDINGS (MANAGEMENT, CONTROL AND ALLOTMENT) ACT, 2018

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Provincial Buildings (Management, Control and Allotment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the management, control, allotment, and cancellation of Provincial buildings within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It defines key terms such as 'allottee', 'Estate Officer', and 'Provincial building' while establishing the authority responsible for managing government offices and rest houses.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Local Government Act, 2013.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Local Government Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for local governments in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, including village, neighbourhood, tehsil, and district councils. It outlines their composition, functions, financial management, taxation powers, and mechanisms for supervision and enforcement of laws.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA MINES AND MINERALS ACT, 2017.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Mines and Minerals Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for mining and minerals in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to improve governance and foster development. It regulates mining procedures, defines mineral titles and agreements, and sets out obligations for title holders including royalty payments and environmental compliance.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2017.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2017
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Urban Immoveable Property Tax Act, 1958; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1990; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act levies, continues, and revises certain taxes within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It amends existing legislation regarding urban immovable property tax, finance acts from 1990 and 2013, and introduces new tax categories for ride-hailing services.

name: The Peshawar Development Authority Act, 2017.

metadata.title: The Peshawar Development Authority Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Peshawar Development Authority to manage and develop the Authority area within Peshawar Division. It outlines the powers, functions, and financial mechanisms of the Authority while providing for the preparation of schemes, acquisition of land, and penalties for violations.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Regularization of Services of Teaching Assistant as Lecturers Act, 2017.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Regularization of Services of Teaching Assistants as Lecturers Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of Teaching Assistants appointed in Government Colleges by the Higher Education, Archives and Libraries Department as Lecturers. It deems these incumbents to have been validly selected and appointed on a regular basis from the date of the Act's commencement, subject to specific conditions regarding qualifications and appointment processes.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Private Schools Regulatory Authority Act, 2017.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Private Schools Regulatory Authority Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Private Schools Regulatory Authority to register and regulate private schools within the province. It defines the authority's composition, functions, funding mechanisms, and procedures for school registration and penalties for violations.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA EMPLOYEES OF TRANSPORT DEPARTMENT (REGULARIZATION OF SERVICES) ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Employees of Transport Department (Regularization of Services) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for employees appointed on a contract or fixed pay basis in specific projects within the Transport & Mass Transit Department. It deems these employees to have been validly appointed on a regular basis from the date the Act comes into force, subject to certain conditions regarding service duration and verification.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Mental Health Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Mental Health Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Mental Health Authority within the province. It provides a legal framework for the treatment, care, and management of properties and affairs of mentally disordered persons and their families.

name: Boilers and Pressure Vessels Act, 2016.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Boilers and Pressure Vessels Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act regulates boilers and pressure vessels within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes a Safety Board, defines key terms like 'boiler' and 'owner', sets registration requirements, and outlines penalties for illegal use or tampering.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Sarhad Development Authority Act, 1972

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Sarhad Development Authority Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sarhad Development Authority to promote economic and industrial development in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It defines the Authority's corporate structure, share capital, management board, and powers regarding property acquisition and financial operations.

name: Free Compulsory Primary and Secondary Education Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Free Compulsory Primary and Secondary Education Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for providing free compulsory primary and secondary education to children aged five to sixteen in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It creates a School Attendance Authority to ensure child enrollment, defines reasonable excuses for non-attendance, and sets up a Taleem Fund for student welfare.

name: Planning & Monitoring Cell, Irrigation Employees (Regularization of services) Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Planning & Monitoring Cell, Irrigation Employees (Regularization of Services) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for ten contract or fixed pay employees appointed in the Planning & Monitoring Cell of the Irrigation Department. It deems these employees to have been validly appointed on a regular basis from the date the Act commences, provided they meet the required qualifications and experience.

name: Employees of Health Department (Regularization of Services) Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Employees of Health Department (Regularization of Services) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for employees appointed on adhoc or contract basis in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Health Department. It deems these employees to have been validly appointed on a regular basis from the date of the Act's commencement, subject to specific conditions regarding resignation and misconduct.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the police force for the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province, defining their responsibilities, organization, and appointment procedures. It also creates public safety commissions at provincial, capital city, and district levels to handle complaints and regulate police conduct.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA COMMISSION ON THE STATUS OF WOMEN ACT, 2016

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2016
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Establishment of a Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and reorganizes the Commission on the Status of Women in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to grant it autonomous status. It aims to improve performance, efficiency, and responsiveness in promoting women's rights and eliminating discrimination against women.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA URBAN MASS TRANSIT ACT, 2016.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Urban Mass Transit Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the planning, establishment, regulation, and management of modern and sustainable mass transit systems in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Urban Mobility Authority to coordinate, construct, develop, operate, and maintain these systems while creating provisions for Urban Transport Companies.

name: Taking Over of the Industrial Estate or Economic Zones Act, 2016.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Taking Over of the Industrial Estate or Economic Zones Act, 2016
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Taking Over of the Industrial Estates of Economic Zones Ordinance, 2016; The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Development Authority Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the taking over of Industrial Estates or Economic Zones from the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Development Authority by the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Economic Zones Development and Management Company. It mandates the transfer of all assets, liabilities, records, and employees to the new Company while simultaneously repealing the previous Ordinance and the original 1972 Act.

name: Prohibition of Interest on Private Loans Act, 2016.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Prohibition of Interest on Private Loans Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the business and practices of private money-lending and advancing loans based on interest within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It defines key terms such as 'money lender' and 'interest', establishes penalties for contravention including imprisonment and fines, and aims to align financial practices with Islamic injunctions against charging interest.

name: Whistleblower Protection and Vigilance Commission Act, 2016.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Whistleblower Protection and Vigilance Commission Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Whistleblower Protection and Vigilance Commission within the province. It provides a legal framework to enable citizens to make public interest disclosures regarding irregular, illegal, or corrupt practices while protecting them from disadvantageous measures.

name: Higher Education Academy of Research and Training Act, 2016.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Higher Education Academy of Research and Training Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Higher Education Academy of Research and Training as a body corporate to provide training for academic and managerial staff. The Academy aims to develop professional competence, research capabilities, and ethical standards among personnel in higher education.

name: BRAINS Institute Act, 2016.

metadata.title: The BRAINS Institute Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the BRAINS Institute in Peshawar as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the Institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy, including the power to award degrees in management, information technology, and engineering.

name: Blood Transfusion Safety Authority Act, 2016.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Blood Transfusion Safety Authority Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the collection, testing, processing, storage, distribution, and transfusion of human blood and blood components in both public and private sectors within Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Blood Transfusion Safety Authority to ensure health protection and prevent transfusion-transmissible diseases.

name: Tibb and Homeopathic Employees (Appointment) Act, 2016.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Tibb and Homeopathic Employees (Appointment) Act, 2016
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Tibb and Homeopathic Employees (Regulation of Services) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of certain Tibb and Homeopathic employees on a regular basis within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It consolidates laws regarding these employees to ensure uniformity and removes doubts concerning their status, while also determining seniority among regularized staff.

name: Faculty of Paramedical and Allied Health Sciences Act, 2016.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Faculty of Paramedical and Allied Health Sciences Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act re-constitutes and re-organizes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Medical Faculty to grant it necessary autonomy. It aims to raise training standards, improve administration, and regulate the education of paramedics and allied health professionals in the province.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Elimination of Custom of Ghag Act, 2013.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Elimination of Custom of Ghag Act, 2013
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Elimination of Custom of Ghag Ordinance, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the practice of 'Ghag', a custom where a person forcibly demands a woman's hand in marriage without her consent. It establishes punishments including imprisonment and fines for those who commit or abet this offence, while also repealing the previous 2012 Ordinance on the same subject.

name: Sacked Employees (Appointment) Act, 2012.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Sacked Employees (Appointment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act provides relief to sacked employees in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government service who were dismissed, removed, or terminated between 1996 and 1998. It authorizes their reappointment on a regular basis against thirty percent of available vacancies in their respective departments.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN PUBLICATION OF BOOKS (REGULATION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Publication of Books (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates and controls the printing and publication of books or works first published in a foreign country within West Pakistan. It establishes restrictions on publishing such materials without government permission, outlines procedures for applications and appeals, and defines penalties including imprisonment, fines, and forfeiture of copies for contraventions.

name: THE AMB (ADMINISTRATION) REGULATION, 1969

metadata.title: The Amb (Administration) Regulation, 1969
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for administrative changes in the Tribal Area comprising the former State of Amb. It ceases the Ruler from exercising administrative functions, transfers civil servants to the Provincial Government, and continues existing laws until altered.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN TRIBUNALS OF INQUIRY ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tribunals of Inquiry Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment of Tribunals, Commissions, or Committees of Inquiry to investigate matters of public importance. It vests these bodies with specific powers similar to a civil court, including summoning witnesses, seizing documents, and issuing commissions.

name: THE DIR, CHITRAL AND SWAT (ADMINISTRATION) REGULATION, 1969

metadata.title: The Dir, Chitral and Swat (Administration) Regulation, 1969
metadata.repeals: The Dir (Administration) Regulation, 1967
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for administrative changes in the Tribal Areas comprising the former states of Dir, Chitral, and Swat. It ceases Rulers from exercising administrative functions, transfers civil servants to the Provincial Government, and restructures tax revenues to the Province.

name: Criminal Law (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1968

metadata.title: The Criminal Law (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance makes special provision for the trial of certain offences in specific areas of West Pakistan. It establishes Tribunals and outlines the exclusive jurisdiction of Deputy Commissioners to take cognizance of scheduled offences, while excluding the application of standard Evidence and Criminal Procedure Acts.

name: West Pakistan Government Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962, (Extension to Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1968

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962 (Extension to Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1968
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Government Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Regulation extends the West Pakistan Government Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962 to the Tribal Areas of West Pakistan. It also applies specific provisions of the Revenue Recovery Act, 1890 to these areas for the purposes of the said Ordinance.

name: Civil Procedure (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1968

metadata.title: The Civil Procedure (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a special procedure for adjudicating certain civil nature disputes in specific areas of West Pakistan. It provides for the constitution of Tribunals to handle these disputes and outlines their powers, composition, and procedures, while barring the jurisdiction of regular courts for these matters.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Real Estate Agents and Motor Vehicles Dealers (Regulation of Business) Ordinance, 1983.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Real Estate Agents and Motor Vehicles Dealers (Regulation of Business) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the business of real estate agents and motor vehicle dealers in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes requirements for registration, defines key terms, and sets procedures for obtaining certificates of registration.

name: Children Infectious Diseases Hospital (Peshawar Municipal Corporation), (Taking Over) Ordinance, 1983.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Children Infectious Diseases Hospital (Peshawar Municipal Corporation), (Taking Over) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the taking over of the Children Infectious Diseases Hospital in Peshawar from the Municipal Corporation to the Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It details the transfer of assets, liabilities, and employees, establishes a committee to settle accounts, and outlines financial contributions required from the Corporation for maintenance.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA ESTABLISHMENT OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY BOARD ACT, 2011

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Establishment of Information Technology Board Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Information Technology Board to promote, plan, execute, supervise, evaluate, and regulate ICT services for both public and private sectors in the province. It defines the Board's corporate status, composition, powers, functions, and administrative structure, including provisions for its fund, accounts, and staff.

name: Establishment of District Development Advisory Committees Act, 1989

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Establishment of District Development Advisory Committees Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act establishes District Development Advisory Committees in each district of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to oversee local development activities. It defines the committee's composition, including elected representatives and co-opted members, and outlines its functions such as formulating proposals for the Annual Development Programme.

name: Advisers and Special Assistants to the Chief Minister (Appointment) Act, 1989.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Advisers and Special Assistants to the Chief Minister (Appointment) Act, 1989
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Advisers and Special Assistants to the Chief Minister (Appointment) Ordinance, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of Advisers and Special Assistants to assist the Chief Minister in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It outlines their tenure, remuneration, and functions assigned by the Chief Minister upon the Governor's advice.

name: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1968

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1968
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes and surcharges in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes specific rates for agricultural income-tax surcharges, cinema taxes, motor vehicle tax surcharges, and railway fare taxes for the financial year 1968-69.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Workers’ Compensation Act, 2013.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Workers' Compensation Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of compensation to workers or their legal heirs by certain classes of employers in case of injury or death by accident. It establishes the liability of employers, defines terms such as 'dependent' and 'disablement', and outlines procedures for claims, medical examinations, and the appointment of commissioners.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Right to Information Act, 2013.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Right to Information Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act ensures transparency and access to information within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It grants every citizen the right to access information held by public bodies, subject to specific rules and reasonable restrictions.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA PUBLIC PROCUREMENT REGULATORY AUTHORITY ACT, 2012.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Procurement Regulatory Authority Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal and regulatory framework for public procurement within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It creates a Public Procurement Regulatory Authority to oversee processes including bid solicitation, evaluation, contract award, and grievance redressal.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Press, Newspapers, News Agencies and Books Registration Act, 2013.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Press, Newspapers, News Agencies and Books Registration Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of press, newspapers, news agencies, and books registration in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes requirements for declarations by printers and publishers, restrictions on foreign ownership, and penalties for contravention of its provisions.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Payment of Wages Act, 2013.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Payment of Wages Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the payment of wages to certain classes of persons employed in factories, industrial establishments, and commercial establishments within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes rules regarding wage periods, time of payment, permissible deductions, inspector powers, penalties for offenses, and procedures for claims related to unpaid wages.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Minimum Wages Act, 2013.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Minimum Wages Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act regulates minimum rates of wages and various allowances for different categories of workers employed in specific industrial and commercial undertakings within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes a Minimum Wages Board to recommend and declare these rates, while also defining terms related to employers, factories, and commercial establishments.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Maternity Benefits Act, 2013.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Maternity Benefits Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and rationalizes the law regarding the employment of women under certain natural conditions in establishments within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes rights for maternity benefits, prohibits the employment of women during specific periods surrounding childbirth, and outlines penalties for employers who contravene these provisions.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Industrial Statistics Act, 2013.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Industrial Statistics Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the collection of statistics relating to factories, industries, and commercial establishments within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes a Statistics Authority empowered to call for returns and information regarding labour conditions, wages, employment, and other specified matters.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Industrial and Commercial Employment (STANDING ORDERS) Act, 2013.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Industrial and Commercial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of industrial and commercial employment within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes definitions, sets penalties for violations, and outlines protections against discrimination and obstruction of inspectors.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2013.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2013
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Revenue Authority and provides for the levy, continuation, and exemption of certain taxes, cess, and fees within the province. It also amends and consolidates existing laws regarding the imposition, collection, and administration of taxes on services.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Explosives Substances Act, 2013.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Explosive Substances Act, 2013
metadata.repeals: The Explosive Substances Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of explosive substances within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes punishments for causing explosions, attempting to cause explosions, and possessing explosives under suspicious circumstances, while also outlining provisions for property forfeiture and trial restrictions.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Explosives Act, 2013.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Explosives Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the manufacture, possession, use, sale, and transportation of explosives within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes an Inspectorate of Explosives and defines various powers regarding licensing, prohibitions, penalties, and accident inquiries.

name: Cessation of Payment of Arrears on Advance Increments on Higher Educational Qualification Act, 2012

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Cessation of Payment of Arrears on Advance Increments on Higher Educational Qualification Act, 2012
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Cessation of Payment of Arrears on Advance Increments on Higher Educational Qualification Ordinance, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act ceases the payment of arrears accrued from advance increments granted to provincial government employees based on higher educational qualifications. It declares that claims for such payments made before December 1, 2001, are non-existent and revokes relevant prior instruments, while deeming amounts already paid as validly settled.

name: Borstal Institution Act, 2012

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Borstal Institutions Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment and regulation of Borstal Institutions in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It aims to detain juveniles while providing them with basic education, training, and care for their mental, moral, and psychological development.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Arms Act, 2013.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Arms Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the manufacture, conversion, repair, sale, transport, bearing, and possession of arms or ammunition in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes provisions for licensing, prohibits unlicensed activities, defines various types of arms and ammunition, and outlines penalties for breaches.

name: Tuberculosis Notification Act, 2016.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Tuberculosis Notification Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act declares Tuberculosis a notifiable disease within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes duties for registered medical practitioners, private clinics, hospitals, and community leaders to report cases using specific notification forms developed by the Provincial Program.

name: Adhoc Employees of Directorate of Information Technology (Regularization of Services) Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Adhoc Employees of Directorate of Information Technology (Regularization of Services) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services of certain employees appointed on an adhoc basis in the Directorate of Information Technology, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, who were hired in 2011. It determines their pay scales, seniority, and establishes that their appointments are deemed valid from the date of the Act's commencement.

name: Promotion of Regional Languages Authority Act, 2012.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Promotion of Regional Languages Authority Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Regional Languages Authority to teach and promote regional languages within the province. It defines the Authority's constitution, including ex-officio members and nominated representatives, and outlines its powers, functions, and operational procedures.

name: Enforcement of Women Ownership Rights Act, 2012.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Enforcement of Women Ownership Rights Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act protects and secures the right of ownership for women in property within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province. It prohibits any person from depriving a woman of her property and prescribes imprisonment and fines for violations, while also establishing specific timelines for court decisions.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Judicial Academy Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Judicial Academy as a body corporate to provide training and higher education for judicial officers and personnel involved in the administration of justice. It outlines the aims, objectives, governance structure, and functions of the Academy, including conducting research, holding seminars, and promoting ethical values within the legal system.

name: Publication of Holy Quran (Elimination of Printing and Recording Errors) Act, 2012

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Publication of the Holy Quran (Elimination of Printing and Recording Errors) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act ensures the publication and recording of the Holy Quran are free from printing and recording errors within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes a Quran Board to authenticate standard copies, registers publishers and recording companies, and sets specific rules for printing processes, paper usage, and text verification.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extra-Assistant Commissioners-cum-Illaqa Qazi (Regularization of Services) Act, 2012

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extra-Assistant Commissioners-cum-Illaqa Qazi (Regularization of Services) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for Extra-Assistant Commissioners-cum-Illaqa Qazis who were appointed on a contract basis. It deems these employees to have been validly appointed on a regular basis from the date of this Act's commencement and determines their seniority based on continuous officiation.

name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Laws (Amendments) Act, 2011.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Laws (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends all existing Acts, Ordinances, rules, regulations, and other legal instruments in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. Its primary purpose is to substitute references to 'North-West Frontier Province' with 'Khyber Pakhtunkhwa' throughout these laws to conform with Article 1 of the Constitution following the Eighteenth Amendment.

name: Iqra National University Act, 2011

metadata.title: The Iqra National University Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Iqra National University at Peshawar in the private sector. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, and various authorities like the Board of Governors and Syndicate.

name: Supervision of Curricula, Text Board and Maintenance of Standards of Education Act, 2011

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Supervision of Curricula, Textbooks and Maintenance of Standards of Education Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a framework for supervising curricula, textbooks, and educational standards across primary through intermediate levels in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It creates a Competent Authority empowered to prepare study schemes, approve textbooks, and direct amendments or deletions to educational materials. The legislation also defines penalties for non-compliance with directives issued by this authority.

name: Finance Act, 2011.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act continues and revises certain taxes and fees in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It amends various existing laws, including the Court Fees Act, Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, Motor Vehicles Ordinance, and previous Finance Acts to update rates and regulations.

name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Appointment, Deputation, Posting and Transfer of Teachers, Lecturers, Instructors and Doctors) Regulatory Act, 2011.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Appointment, Deputation, Posting and Transfer of Teachers, Lecturers, Instructors and Doctors) Regulatory Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the appointment, posting, and transfer of teachers in primary through higher secondary schools, lecturers in colleges, instructors in technical institutions, and doctors in health facilities within Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes rules for filling vacancies based on merit and educational clusters, including provisions for transfers upon marriage or when eligible candidates are unavailable in the local cluster.

name: Removal From Service (Special Powers) (Repeal) Act, 2011.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Repeal) Act, 2011
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000. It ensures that pending proceedings under the repealed ordinance continue until resolved, after which disciplinary matters revert to the standard Civil Servants Act and related rules.

name: Appointment of Certain Lecturers Act, 2011.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Appointment of certain Lecturers Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of 137 lecturers on a regular basis who were previously working under contract. It deems these lecturers to have been validly appointed on a regular basis as of the commencement of the Act, subject to verification of their holding of posts by December 31, 2008.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Zakat and Ushr Act, 2011

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Zakat and Ushr Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act provides provisions for the assessment, collection, and disbursement of Zakat and Ushr within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes the necessary administrative bodies, such as the Zakat Funds and various committees, to manage these religious obligations in accordance with Shariah principles.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA EMERGENCY RESCUE SERVICE ACT, 2012.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Emergency Rescue Service Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Emergency Rescue Service, known as Rescue 1122, to maintain preparedness for emergencies. It provides a legal framework for timely response, rescue operations, and emergency medical treatment for persons affected by disasters.

name: Finance Act, 2010

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2010
metadata.amends: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. III of 2000
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and revises certain taxes within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes a capital value tax on immovable property acquired through purchase, gift, exchange, or other means, excluding inheritance or specific familial gifts.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA CHILD PROTECTION AND WELFARE ACT, 2010.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Child Protection and Welfare Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: Ordinance No. II of 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the care, protection, maintenance, welfare, training, education, rehabilitation, and reintegration of children at risk in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes a Child Protection and Welfare Commission, creates specific courts for child cases, defines various offences against children, and outlines penalties and procedures for their rescue and protection.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA PROVINCIAL OMBUDSMAN ACT, 2010.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Provincial Ombudsman Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the office of the Provincial Ombudsman in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It aims to protect citizens' rights, ensure adherence to the rule of law, and rectify injustices caused by maladministration.

name: Chashma Right Bank Canal (Lift-cum-Gravity) Project (Control and Prevention of Speculation in Land) Act, 2010

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Chashma Right Bank Canal (Lift-cum-Gravity) Project (Control and Prevention of Speculation in Land) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to control land purchases and alienations within the Chashma Right Bank Canal Project area to prevent speculation. It establishes a bar on transferring project lands until water availability for irrigation, allows for the annulment of certain prior speculative transfers, and provides mechanisms for government acquisition and valuation of affected lands.

name: Malakand Protected Area (Vesting of Evacuee Property in Government) Regulation, 2010

metadata.title: The Malakand Protected Area (Vesting of Evacuee Property in Government) Regulation, 2010
metadata.summary: This Regulation extinguishes the rights of evacuees in properties located within the Malakand Protected Area and vests such properties wholly in the Government. It declares all transactions regarding these properties made immediately before its commencement as null and void.

name: University of Swat Regulation, 2010

metadata.title: The University of Swat Regulation, 2010
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for the establishment of the University of Swat and matters connected therewith. It outlines the powers, functions, and structure of the University's authorities, including the Senate, Syndicate, and Academic Council.

name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Development Authority Mineral Wing (Taking Over) Act, 2009

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Development Authority Mineral Wing (Taking-Over) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the taking over of the Mineral Wing of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Development Authority by the Government. It also facilitates the absorption of the wing's employees into the Exploration Promotion Division of the Directorate General of Mines and Minerals.

name: The Defence Housing Authority Peshawar Act, 2009

metadata.title: The Defence Housing Authority Peshawar Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Defence Housing Authority Peshawar as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the composition and management structure of the Authority, including the Governing Body and Executive Board, and defines their respective powers and functions.

name: Finance Act, 2009

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act continues, revises, and exempts certain taxes and fees in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It substitutes schedules for existing West Pakistan Acts from 1958 and amends specific ordinances and acts related to real estate agents, motor vehicles dealers, and finance regulations.

name: The Abasyn University Act, 2009

metadata.title: The Abasyn University Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Abasyn University in Peshawar within the private sector. It outlines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, and governing bodies such as the Senate and Syndicate.

name: Employees (Regularization of Services) Act, 2009

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Employees (Regularization of Services) Act, 2009
metadata.repeals: The North-West Frontier Province Employees (Regularization of Services) Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for certain employees appointed on an adhoc or contract basis in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It deems these employees to have been validly appointed on a regular basis as of December 31, 2008, while establishing rules for their seniority and overriding conflicting laws.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Preventive Health Act, 2009

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Preventive Health Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes preventive health measures specifically for marriages within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It mandates that Nikah Registrars obtain premarital screening test reports for Thalassemia and Hepatitis C before solemnizing a marriage, while ensuring these results do not affect the validity of the marriage.

name: The Paraplegic Center (Taking Over and Re-Establishment) Act, 2009

metadata.title: The Paraplegic Centre (Taking over and Re-establishment) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the taking over of the Paraplegic Centre located at Hayatabad, Peshawar, from the Pakistan Red Crescent Society. It re-establishes the Centre under the administrative control of the Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to continue treating spinal cord injuries in the public interest.

name: THE SHARIAH NIZAM-E-ADL REGULATION, 2009.

metadata.title: The Shariah Nizam-e-Adl Regulation, 2009
metadata.summary: This Regulation establishes a framework for the implementation of Shariah through courts in the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It defines the powers and functions of Qazis, outlines court procedures, and specifies which existing laws continue to apply or cease to operate within the designated area.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Senior Citizens Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Senior Citizens Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Senior Citizens Welfare Council to oversee the well-being, comfort, and dignity of senior citizens in the province. It defines the composition, powers, and functions of the Council, including policy formulation, research on aging, and the establishment of a welfare fund.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Surrender of Illicit Arms Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Surrender of Illicit Arms Act, 2014
