metadata.summary: This Act provides for the surrender of illicit arms within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to improve law and order. It defines various types of illicit arms, establishes procedures for surrender including those by persons abroad, mandates publicity efforts, and outlines punishments for contravention.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Tibb and Homeopathic Employees (Regularization of Services) Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Tibb and Homeopathic Employees (Regularization of Services) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for Tibb and Homeopathic employees who were appointed on a contract or ad-hoc basis. It deems these employees to have been validly appointed on a regular basis if they held their posts as of June 30, 2010, or until the Act commenced.

name: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas Provincial Levies Force Regulation, 2014

metadata.title: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas Provincial Levies Force Regulation, 2014
metadata.summary: This Regulation constitutes and regulates the Provincial Levies Force in the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (PATA) of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It defines the roles of officers, outlines specific functions such as road security and anti-smuggling activities, and establishes the administrative structure under the supervision of the Government.

name: Kalri Lake Development (Repeal) Act, 1964.

metadata.title: The Kalri Lake Development (Repeal) Act, 1964
metadata.repeals: The Kalri Lake Development Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Kalri Lake Development Ordinance, 1959. It provides for the transfer of all assets, liabilities, contracts, and employees from the dissolved Board to the West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation.

name: The West Pakistan Firewood and Charcoal (Restriction) Act, 1964.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Firewood and Charcoal (Restriction) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits and regulates the burning of firewood and charcoal in factories, brick-kilns, lime-kilns, and other specified places within West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'factory' and 'firewood', outlines restrictions with specific exceptions for domestic use and personal proprietor use, and establishes penalties including imprisonment or fines for contravention.

name: The West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief Act) Extension to Tribal Areas Regulation, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief Act) (Extension to Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This regulation extends the provisions of the West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958 to the Tribal Areas of Dera Ismail Khan and Peshawar Divisions. It was made by the Governor of West Pakistan with the approval of the President under the authority granted by Article 223 of the Constitution.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Rural Area Drinking Water Supply Scheme Act, 1985.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Rural Area Drinking Water Supply Scheme Act, 1985
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the execution and administration of drinking water supply schemes in rural areas of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It outlines procedures for applying for connections, collecting fees, disconnecting supplies for non-payment, and defines offences related to damaging water infrastructure.

name: Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Ordinance, 1982.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the improvement of the constitution and working of certain Co-operative Societies in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes specific rules regarding apex societies, including membership restrictions, committee composition, and the overriding effect of its provisions on other laws.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Civil Servants Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Civil Servants Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the appointment of persons to and the terms and conditions of service for civil servants in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It provides a comprehensive framework covering tenure, promotion, transfers, disciplinary actions, and benefits such as pension and provident fund.

name: Provincially Administered Tribal Areas Skiing-cum-Tourist Resort Project (Control on Mushroom Construction and Prevention of Speculation in Land Regulation, 1983.

metadata.title: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas Skiing-cum-Tourist Resort Project (Control on Mushroom Construction and Prevention of Speculation in Land) Regulation, 1983
metadata.number: N.-W. F. P. REGULATION NO. 1 OF 1983
metadata.summary: This regulation controls construction and prevents land speculation within the Skiing-cum-Tourist Resort Project area in Malam Jabba, Swat District. It establishes a ban on building construction near the project area and restricts the alienation of project land for fifteen years from its commencement.

name: West Pakistan Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law regarding the control of cotton production, processing, and sale in West Pakistan. It establishes a Cotton Control Board and Advisory Committees to regulate these activities, including licensing for factories and marking of bales.

name: West Pakistan Cooperative Societies and Co-operative Banks (Repayment of Loans) Ordinance, 1966.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Co-operative Societies and Co-operative Banks (Repayment of Loans) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the securing and repayment of unsecured loans or loans that are insufficiently secured taken from co-operative banks and societies. It applies to the whole of the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (formerly West Pakistan) except the Tribal Areas and comes into force immediately.

name: Provincially Administered Tribal Areas Levies Force Regulation, 2012.

metadata.title: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas Levies Force Regulation, 2012
metadata.summary: This Regulation constitutes and regulates the service matters of the Levies Force in the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (PATA) of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It defines the powers, duties, liabilities, and indemnity for officers and members of the Force, while outlining functions such as ensuring road security, guarding institutions, and maintaining law and order.

name: The Provincial Services Academy (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa) Act, 2013.

metadata.title: The Provincial Services Academy (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Provincial Services Academy in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa as a body corporate to provide training and research for officers with executive functions. It outlines the objectives of the Academy, including curriculum development, conducting seminars, and serving as a research institute for the government.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Civil Servants Retirement Benefits and Death Compensation Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Civil Servants Retirement Benefits and Death Compensation Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a specific fund to provide retirement benefits and death compensation for civil servants of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province. It creates a Board of Management to control, supervise, and administer this Fund, outlining its composition, powers, and investment guidelines.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ehtesab Commission Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ehtesab Commission Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ehtesab Commission as an autonomous and accountable anti-corruption institution within the province. It creates an effective institutional structure to prevent corruption, hold public office holders accountable for misconduct, and ensure the recovery of misappropriated government assets.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Evacuee Trust Properties (Management and Disposal) Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Evacuee Trust Properties (Management and Disposal) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the management and disposal of evacuee properties attached to charitable, religious, or educational trusts or institutions within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes an Evacuee Trust Property Board with specific powers to acquire, hold, and dispose of such properties while maintaining records and submitting annual budgets.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Farm Services Centres Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Farm Services Centres Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment and regularisation of Farm Services Centres in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa through public-private partnerships. It defines the functions of these centres, which include safeguarding farmers' rights, enhancing agricultural knowledge, boosting modernization, and providing inputs like seeds and machinery at affordable rates.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2014
metadata.amends: The Stamp Act, 1899; The West Pakistan Urban Immoveable Property Tax Act, 1958; The West Pakistan Shops and Establishment Ordinance, 1969; The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act 1990; The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act 1995; The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act 1996; The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. IV of 2000
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy, continuation, revision, and exemption of certain taxes, fees, cess, and duties in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It amends several existing statutes, including the Stamp Act, Urban Immoveable Property Tax Act, Shops and Establishment Ordinance, and previous Finance Acts to update tax rates and schedules.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Food Safety Authority Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Food Safety and Halal Food Authority Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Food Safety and Halal Food Authority to regulate food safety standards, including Halal food. It provides for the licensing of food businesses, enforcement mechanisms against unsafe or adulterated food, and penalties for non-compliance.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Higher Education Scholarship Endowment Fund Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Higher Education Scholarship Endowment Fund Act, 2014
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Higher Education Scholarship Endowment Fund Ordinance, 2013 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. I of 2014)
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Higher Education Endowment Fund to provide scholarships for students in public and private colleges based on merit and affordability. It creates a Board to control and manage the fund, which is initially capitalized with 800 million rupees. The legislation also repeals the previous Ordinance from 2013.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Hotels Restriction (Security) Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Hotels Restriction (Security) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a mechanism to monitor hotels and guests within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province for counter-terrorism and crime prevention purposes. It mandates that hotel owners, lessees, or managers provide registration details to local police, verify guest identities using National Identity Cards, check baggage for prohibited items, and maintain daily records of guests.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Injured Persons and Emergency (Medical Aid) Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Injured Persons and Emergency (Medical Aid) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the medical aid and treatment of injured persons in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa during emergencies. It establishes priority treatment protocols, restricts police interference, and mandates free care at notified hospitals.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA JOURNALISTS WELFARE ENDOWMENT FUND ACT, 2014.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Journalists Welfare Endowment Fund Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Journalists Welfare Endowment Fund to support deserving journalists in the province. It provides for the constitution of a committee, defines terms related to journalist welfare, and outlines provisions for financial assistance, compensation, and fund maintenance.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA MEDICAL TRANSPLANTATION REGULATORY AUTHORITY ACT, 2014.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Medical Transplantation Regulatory Authority Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Medical Transplantation Regulatory Authority to regulate the removal, storage, and transplantation of human organs, tissues, and cells for therapeutic purposes within the province. It defines key terms such as 'donor' and 'death', sets rules for living and deceased donations, creates various committees for evaluation and monitoring, and prescribes punishments for unauthorized removal or commercial dealings in human organs.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Protection of Communal Properties of Minorities Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Protection of Communal Properties of Minorities Act, 2014
metadata.repeals: The Protection of Communal Properties of Minorities Ordinance, 2001 (Ordinance No. V of 2002)
metadata.summary: This Act protects the properties of minority communities in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa that are meant for their communal use. It establishes a Commission to oversee these matters and imposes a ban on the sale or transfer of such properties without a No Objection Certificate from the Government.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Regulation of Lady Health Workers Program and Employees (Regularization and Standardization) Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Regulation of Lady Health Workers Program and Employees (Regularization and Standardization) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the status of the Lady Health Workers Program in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province following its devolution from the Federal Government. It aims to regularize and standardize the services of program employees, defining their recruitment, posting, retirement benefits, and disciplinary mechanisms.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Restriction of Rented Buildings (Security) Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Restriction of Rented Buildings (Security) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a mechanism to monitor rented buildings in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province for counter-terrorism and crime prevention purposes. It mandates written rent agreements with tenant verification, including references and attestation, and requires landlords and managers to provide specific information to police stations within seven days of signing.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Right to Public Services Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Right to Public Services Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for delivering public services within stipulated time limits in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It defines the roles of various authorities, sets up a dedicated commission to oversee these services, and outlines penalties for government servants who fail to comply with time-bound provisions.

name: Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University, Sheringal Regulation, 2009

metadata.title: The Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University, Sheringal Regulation, 2009
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for the establishment of the Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University at Sheringal and matters connected therewith. It was made by the Governor of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa with the prior approval of the President under Article 247 of the Constitution.

name: Finance Act, 2008

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2008
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act continues, revises, and exempts certain taxes, fines, and fees while enhancing specific penalties. It amends the West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958, and the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, to update tax rates and traffic violation schedules.

name: Finance Act, 2007

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2007
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Sales Tax Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Act continues, revises, and exempts certain taxes and duties within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It amends several existing laws, including the Stamp Act of 1899 and various West Pakistan Acts, to update schedules and provisions regarding tax exemptions and rates.

name: Agricultural and Livestock Produce Market Act, 2007

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Agricultural and Livestock Produce Markets Act, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act amends and consolidates the law relating to the marketing of agricultural and livestock produce in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes market committees, defines various terms related to produce and dealers, and outlines provisions for licences, fees, and penalties.

name: Prohibition of Kite Flying Activities Act, 2006

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Prohibition of Kite Flying Activities Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits kite flying activities in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province to ensure human life and property safety. It defines specific offenses related to kite manufacturing, sale, and flying with dangerous materials, along with penalties including imprisonment and fines.

name: Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Conservation and Exploitation of Certain Forests) (Repeal) Regulation, 2006

metadata.title: Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Conservation and Exploitation of Certain Forests) (Repeal) Regulation, 2006
metadata.repeals: Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Conservation and Exploitation of Certain Forests) Regulation, 1980
metadata.summary: This regulation was made by the Governor of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa with the President's approval to repeal an earlier forest conservation law from 1980. It specifically targets the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas adjoining Mansehra District known as the Black Mountain Range.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2005

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Prosecution Institution in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province to reorganize and manage prosecution functions. It defines the powers, duties, and conduct of public prosecutors, including their liaison with the Advocate General and reporting requirements.

name: Validation of Standing Order Act, 2005

metadata.title: The Validation of Standing Order Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act validates the rights created by Standing Order No. 11 of 1987 issued by the Inspector General of Police regarding police personnel promotion and seniority. It deems these rights and appointments made under that order to have validly accrued despite any procedural deficiencies or existing service rules.

name: Finance Act, 2005

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2005
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; West Pakistan Shops and Establishment Ordinance, 1969; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Sales Tax Ordinance, 2000; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Land Tax and Agriculture Income Tax Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Act remits certain taxes and enhances fines for specific offences within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It amends existing legislation regarding urban immovable property tax, shops and establishment ordinances, sales tax, and land/agriculture income tax to provide tax relief for industrial units and adjust penalty amounts.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Housing Authority Act, 2005

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Housing Authority Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Housing Authority to implement a comprehensive system of town planning and achieve the objective of 'Housing for All'. It defines the powers, functions, and structure of the Authority, including provisions for funds, schemes, and penalties.

name: Agricultural Research System (Handing Over) (Repeal) Act, 2005

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Agricultural Research System (Handing Over) (Repeal) Act, 2005
metadata.repeals: North-West Frontier Province Agricultural Research System (Handing Over) Act, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the North-West Frontier Province Agricultural Research System (Handing Over) Act, 1986. It transfers any assets and liabilities acquired under the repealed Act to the Agriculture Department.

name: Medical Relief Endowment Fund Act, 2004

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Medical Relief) Endowment Fund Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Medical Relief) Endowment Fund to provide free medical treatment to poor individuals suffering from specified serious diseases. It outlines the fund's initial capital, sources of income, and the composition and powers of a committee responsible for its control, management, and audit.

name: Finance Act, 2004

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act continues, abolishes, and revises certain taxes, cesses, fees, and duties in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province. It amends several existing acts related to stamp duties, motor vehicle ordinances, and finance acts from 1990, 1995, and 1996.

name: Higher Education Research Endowment Fund Act, 2004.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Higher Education Research Endowment Fund Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Higher Education Research Endowment Fund in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to finance research activities in public sector universities. It outlines the fund's purpose, including grants for students and faculty, scholarships for deserving students, and support for private sector scholars and retired government servants. The Act also defines the composition of the Board responsible for controlling and managing the fund.

name: Prevention of Conflict of Interest Act, 2016.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Prevention of Conflict of Interest Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Prevention of Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commission to regulate public office holders in the province. It aims to prevent conflicts between private interests and public duties by defining specific principles, establishing an independent commission, and providing for punitive measures against violations.

name: Galiyat Development Authority Act, 2016.

metadata.title: The Galiyat Development Authority Act, 2016
metadata.repeals: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. VII 2016
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and reorganizes the Galiyat Development Authority to manage the development of Galiyat areas and other regions within the Hazara Division. It grants autonomy to the Authority for better management, ensures private sector representation, and establishes powers regarding taxation, borrowing, and scheme execution.

name: Sports Foundation Act, 2003.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Sports Foundation Act, 2003
metadata.repeals: The North-West Frontier Province Sports Foundation Ordinance, 2003 (N.W.F.P. Ordinance No. VIII of 2003)
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Sports Foundation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the foundation's purposes, which include providing stipends to retired sportsmen, offering scholarships, imparting coaching, and organizing competitions. The legislation also defines the composition of the Administrative Committee and provisions for an Endowment Fund.

name: Rivers Protection Ordinance, 2002.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Rivers Protection Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the protection of aquatic ecology, water quality, and the economic and environmental value of rivers and their tributaries in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It addresses threats from unplanned construction, encroachment, and urbanization by establishing prohibitions, zoning plans, building controls, and powers for authorized officers to enforce regulations.

name: Provincial Urban Development Board (Dissolution) Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Urban Development Board (Dissolution) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Urban Planning Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This ordinance provides for the dissolution of the Provincial Urban Development Board in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It outlines the transfer of the Board's assets, liabilities, and functions to relevant government departments and district governments upon its dissolution.

name: Elementary and Secondary Education Foundation Ordinance, 2002.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Elementary and Secondary Education Foundation Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Elementary and Secondary Education Foundation in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to promote, improve, and finance education. Its primary objective is to strengthen elementary and secondary education within the private sector in alignment with government policy.

name: Investment Facilitation Agency Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Investment Facilitation Agency Ordinance, 2002
metadata.repeals: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Development Authority Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Investment Facilitation Agency as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It also provides for the winding up of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Development Authority and the transfer of its assets and liabilities to the new Agency.

name: The Institute of Management Sciences Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Institute of Management Sciences Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Institute of Management Sciences at Peshawar as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the powers and functions of the Institute, including teaching business administration, conducting examinations, appointing staff, and promoting cooperation with other institutions.

name: Northern University Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Northern University Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of a University of Science and Technology at Nowshera in the private sector. It outlines the powers, functions, and structure of the Northern University, including its authorities, staff, and academic bodies.

name: Private Security Companies Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Private Security Companies Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation, licensing, and control of private security companies in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes procedures for granting licenses, defines prohibited activities such as wearing military-style uniforms or possessing arms without authorization, and outlines penalties for non-compliance.

name: Abaseen Construction Corporation Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Abaseen Construction Corporation Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Abaseen Construction Corporation to undertake developmental works in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It defines the Corporation's structure, including its Board, share capital, and functions such as road construction and maintenance.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 2002
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1990
metadata.summary: This Ordinance revives and modifies certain taxes and duties in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It amends the Stamp Act of 1899 and the Finance Act of 1990, while establishing a specific tax on hotels based on room rent.

name: Preston University Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Preston University Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of Preston University at Kohat in the private sector. It outlines the powers, functions, and structure of the University's various authorities, including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and Board of Governors.

name: Gandhara University Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Gandhara University Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Gandhara University at Peshawar as a private sector institution. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and Board of Governors, while outlining its powers to confer degrees and affiliate educational institutions.

name: Adhoc Public Accounts Committee (Composition and Functions) (Repeal) Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Adhoc Public Accounts Committee (Composition and Functions) (Repeal) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.repeals: North-West Frontier Province Adhoc Public Accounts Committee (Composition and Functions) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This ordinance dissolves the North-West Frontier Province Adhoc Public Accounts Committee following the revival of the Provincial Assembly. It also repeals the previous Ordinance, 2001 that constituted the committee, citing that it no longer serves a purpose after the general election.

name: Integrated Water Resources Management Board Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Integrated Water Resources Management Board Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Integrated Water Resources Management Board to devise and oversee an integrated water resources management strategy. The Board is designed to maximize sustainable economic, social, and environmental returns while managing competing demands for this finite resource.

name: The West Pakistan Qaumi Razakars Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Qaumi Razakars Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Qaumi Razakars Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to Qaumi Razakars in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes the constitution, duties, and control mechanisms for these forces while providing legal protections and powers for their members.

name: The West Pakistan Seeds and Fruit Plants Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Seeds and Fruit Plants Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the better production and distribution of high-quality seeds and fruit plants in West Pakistan. It establishes a system for registering growers, certifying seeds and plants based on specific quality standards, and regulating their sale and distribution.

name: Road Transport Board Removal of Undesirable Employees Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Road Transport Board Removal of Undesirable Employees Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the termination of services of undesirable employees of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Road Transport Board. It establishes procedures for appropriate authorities to terminate employment after giving a reasonable opportunity to show cause, outlines appeal processes to the Government, and grants immunity from legal proceedings for actions taken in good faith under the law.

name: The West Pakistan Regulation and Control of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Regulation and Control of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Regulation of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates and controls the use of loudspeakers and sound amplifiers in West Pakistan to prevent public nuisance and maintain public order. It prohibits their use in residential areas, near hospitals or schools during working hours, and within places of worship at volumes that disturb others.

name: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and abolishes certain taxes and duties in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes specific surcharges on land revenue and agricultural income-tax, as well as new taxes on cinemas, callings, trades, motor vehicles, and railway fares.

name: Tthe West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.repeals: Act No. LXVI of 1950
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the slaughter of useful animals and regulates the slaughter of other animals in West Pakistan. It establishes requirements for stock yard examinations, defines specific categories of useful animals, and sets restrictions on slaughter days and locations.

name: Housing Facilities for Non-proprietors in Rural Areas Act, 1987

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Housing Facilities for Non-Proprietors in Rural Areas Act, 1987
metadata.repeals: Act II of 1976; Ordinance No III of 1987
metadata.summary: This Act provides for housing facilities and land allotment to non-proprietors in rural areas of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes schemes for the development of housing colonies, defines eligibility criteria based on residency and lack of property ownership, and sets up Allotment Committees to scrutinize applications.

name: Ad hoc Civil Servants (Regularization of Services) Act, 1987

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ad hoc Civil Servants (Regularization of Services) Act, 1987
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ad hoc Civil Servants (Regularization of Services) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for certain civil servants who were appointed on an ad hoc basis. It deems their appointments valid if they meet specific qualification, experience, and recommendation criteria as of the commencement date.

name: The West Pakistan Recovery of Cost (Copies of Essential Revenue Records) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Recovery of Cost (Copies of Essential Revenue Records) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recovery of costs incurred by the Government in preparing and supplying copies of essential revenue records to Union Councils. It mandates that these copies be made available for public inspection and establishes the mechanism for recovering preparation costs from land revenue payers.

name: The West Pakistan Industries (Control on Establishment and Enlargement) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Industries (Control on Establishment and Enlargement) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the organized and planned growth of industries in West Pakistan. It restricts the establishment or enlargement of industrial undertakings without prior written permission from the Government.

name: The West Pakistan Anti-Corruption Establishment (Extension to Tribal Areas of [……...] Dera Ismail Khan and Peshawar Divisions) Regulation, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Anti-Corruption Establishment (Extension to Tribal Areas of Dera Ismail Khan and Peshawar Divisions) Regulation, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Regulation extends the West Pakistan Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961 to specific Tribal Areas within the Dera Ismail Khan and Peshawar Divisions. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan with the approval of the President under the authority granted by Article 223 of the Constitution of 1962.

name: WEST PAKISTAN REPEALING ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: West Pakistan Repealing Ordinance, 1970
metadata.repeals: certain enactments specified in the Schedule
metadata.summary: This Ordinance expressly repeals specific enactments listed in the Schedule that are considered spent, unnecessary, or no longer in force. It includes savings provisions to protect previous operations, rights, liabilities, and ongoing legal proceedings from being affected by the repeal.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Adhoc Lecturers (Regularization of Service) Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Adhoc Lecturers (Regularization of Services) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for adhoc lecturers appointed in various colleges of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa between September 2013 and June 2014. It deems these lecturers to have been validly selected and appointed on a regular basis from the date the Act commences, subject to specific conditions regarding qualifications and commission recommendations.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Appointment of Law Officers Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Appointment of Law Officers Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of Law Officers in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to conduct government litigation. It outlines the qualifications, tenure, and conditions of service for these officers, including restrictions on private practice.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 2014

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for more effectual control over the administration of charitable and religious trusts within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes procedures for interested persons to apply to the Court for directions regarding trust details, audits, and expenditures incurred in suits against trustees.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN LAND DISPOSITIONS (SAVING OF SHAMILAT) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Dispositions (Saving of Shamilat) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for a uniform interpretation of general expressions regarding the disposition of 'Shamilat' lands in the Province of West Pakistan. It stipulates that unless specifically mentioned as the subject matter of a disposition, Shamilat lands are not included in such dispositions regardless of general wording used.

name: Newspaper Employees' (Conditions of Service) Act, (Application to Provincially Administered Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1987

metadata.title: The Newspapers Employee's (Conditions of Service) Act, (Application to Provincially Administered Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1987
metadata.repeals: any law, instrument, custom or usage having the force of law corresponding to the Provisions of the Newspaper Employees (Conditions of Service) Act, 1973 in the said Areas
metadata.summary: This regulation applies the Newspapers Employees' (Conditions of Service) Act, 1973 to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of the North-West Frontier Province. It ensures that all rules and orders made under the 1973 Act apply to these areas while repealing any corresponding local laws that were in force immediately before this regulation came into effect.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance (Amendment) Act, 1985

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance (Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.amends: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 1982
metadata.repeals: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 1982 by substituting tax rates and adding an explanation regarding the weight of Gur bags. It also repeals the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985.

name: The Kyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1985

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1985
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Finance Act, 1965; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Gift Tax Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and abolishes certain taxes and cesses in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It repeals the Gift Tax Act of 1963 and amends previous finance acts regarding hotel tax rates and classifications.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 1981
metadata.amends: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1973; The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance abolishes certain fees and cesses in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It omits specific sections from the Finance Act of 1973 and the Finance Act of 1977.

name: Finance Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 1979
metadata.amends: W.P. Act V of 1958; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act XII of 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues and levies certain taxes, cesses, and surcharges in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It amends existing acts regarding urban immovable property tax and motor vehicle fees while establishing procedures for assessment and collection.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Kabul River Project (Control and Prevention of Speculation in Land) Act, 1948

metadata.title: The Kabul River Project (Control and Prevention of Speculation in Land) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act controls land alienation and prevents speculation within the Kabul River Project area in Peshawar district. It empowers the Provincial Government to appoint a Collector, fix land valuations, and annul certain transfers made after December 1, 1947.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Animal Contagious Diseases Act, 1948

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Animal Contagious Diseases Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention and control of contagious diseases affecting animals within Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes the roles of veterinary surgeons and inspectors, outlines powers to regulate trade and transport of infected animals, and defines penalties for contraventions.

name: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and abolishes certain taxes and duties applicable to the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes specific surcharges on agricultural income-tax, taxes on cinemas and motor vehicles, and duties on railway fares and electricity consumption for the financial year 1964-65.

name: The West Pakistan Milk Board Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Milk Boards Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the production and marketing of milk and milk products in West Pakistan. It establishes a Milk Board as a body corporate with powers to acquire property, sue, and be sued, while defining its constitution, functions, and financial management.

name: Chashma Right Bank Canal Project (Control and Prevention of Speculation in Land) (Repeal) Act, 1987

metadata.title: The Chashma Right Bank Canal Project (Control and Prevention of Speculation in Land) (Repeal) Act, 1987
metadata.repeals: The Chashma Right Bank Canal Project (Control and Prevention of Speculation in Land) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to repeal the Chashma Right Bank Canal Project (Control and Prevention of Speculation in Land) Ordinance, 1971. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Preemption Act, 1987

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Pre-emption Act, 1987
metadata.summary: This Act modifies the existing law relating to pre-emption to bring it in conformity with the Injunctions of Islam as set out in the Holy Quran and Sunnah. It defines key terms such as immovable property, pre-emptor, and right of pre-emption, and establishes priorities among different classes of pre-emptors including shafi-sharik, shafi khalit, and shafi-jar.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN FINANCE ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; West Pakistan Act, No. XXIX of 1964; West Pakistan Act No. X of 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues and levies various taxes, cesses, and surcharges in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes specific rates for agricultural income-tax surcharges, cinema tax, motor vehicle tax, railway fare tax, and welfare cesses effective from July 1, 1969.

name: The West Pakistan Redemption and Restitution of Mortgaged Lands Act, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Redemption and Restitution of Mortgaged Lands Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the redemption and restitution of certain mortgages of land in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes procedures for mortgagors to apply for redemption, deposit due amounts, and obtain orders from Collectors for ejectment and possession.

name: THE PROVINCIALLY ADMINISTERED TRIBAL AREAS (APPLICATION OF ELECTIONS LAW) REGULATION, 2001

metadata.title: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Elections Law) Regulation, 2001
metadata.summary: This regulation applies specific Local Government Elections Ordinances and related rules to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It simultaneously causes certain existing laws, instruments, customs, or usages in those areas to cease operating upon its commencement.

name: THE [KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA] EDUCATIONAL TESTING AND EVALUATION AGENCY ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Educational Testing and Evaluation Agency Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes an independent and autonomous Educational Testing and Evaluation Agency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The Agency is tasked with developing resources and systems for educational evaluation and testing to ensure transparent, uninfluenced, and academically sound practices within educational institutions.

name: THE [KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA] AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (DISSOLUTION) ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Agricultural Development Authority (Dissolution) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.repeals: North-West Frontier Province Agricultural Development Authority Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This ordinance provides for the dissolution of the North-West Frontier Province Agricultural Development Authority. It also outlines the transfer of the Authority's assets and liabilities to the Government and addresses the status of its employees upon dissolution.

name: THE [KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA] HIGHWAYS AUTHORITY ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The [Khyber Pakhtunkhwa] Highways Authority Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Highways Authority as a body corporate with perpetual succession to manage provincial highways. It defines the Authority's powers, functions, management structure, and financial provisions for road construction and maintenance.

name: THE [KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA] FRUITS AND VEGETABLES DEVELOPMENT BOARD (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Fruits and Vegetables Development Board (Repeal) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.repeals: North-West Frontier Province Fruits and Vegetables Development Board Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This ordinance repeals the North-West Frontier Province Fruits and Vegetables Development Board Ordinance, 1984, and dissolves the associated Board. It provides for the transfer of all assets, liabilities, and staff matters to the Extension Wing of the Agriculture Department while terminating contract employee services.

name: THE CECOS UNIVERSITY OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY AND EMERGING SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: CECOS University of Information Technology and Emerging Sciences Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of CECOS University of Information Technology and Emerging Sciences at Peshawar in the private sector. It outlines the university's incorporation, powers, functions, organizational structure, and governance authorities.

name: THE [KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA] REGISTRATION AND FUNCTIONING OF PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Registration and Functioning of Private Educational Institutions Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to streamline, supervise, and regulate the functioning of private educational institutions in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes a framework for the registration of private universities, colleges, schools, and societies, while also creating a Regulatory Authority to oversee these institutions.

name: THE [KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA] LAND TAX AND AGRICULTURE INCOME TAX ORDINANCE, 2000

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Land Tax and Agriculture Income Tax Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levying of Land Tax and Agricultural Income Tax in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes definitions, liabilities, assessment procedures, and penalties related to these taxes.

name: THE [KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA] SECRETARIAT ALLOWANCE (RESCISSION OF ORDERS, ETC.) ORDINANCE, 2000

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Secretariat Allowance (Rescission of Orders, etc.) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance rescinds certain orders and instruments that granted Secretariat Allowance to employees of the Provincial Government and related organizations. It deems these rescissions effective from July 15, 1987, and prevents the recovery of already paid allowances while allowing for recompense if difficulties arise in implementation.

name: Fertilizer Control Act, 1999.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Fertilizer Control Act, 1999
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the manufacture, sale, and distribution of fertilizers within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes requirements for fertilizer registration, branding, analysis, and prohibits the sale of fake or adulterated products.

name: Supply of Wheat to Flour Mills Act, 1999

metadata.title: The (Supply of Wheat to Flour Mills) Act, 1999
metadata.repeals: The North-West Frontier Province (Supply of Wheat to Flour Mills) Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the supply of wheat to flour mills in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa due to insufficient local production and limited federal quotas. It restricts wheat supply to non-existing mills only as determined by the Government to ensure economic viability and reasonable prices for the public.

name: Pension Fund Act, 1999.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Pension Fund Act, 1999
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Provincial Pension Fund in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa with initial seed money of Rs. 150 million. It creates a Board to manage the fund, defines its investment and maintenance procedures, and outlines the withdrawal and audit processes.

name: General Provident Investment Fund Act, 1999.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa General Provident Investment Fund Act, 1999
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a General Provident Investment Fund for the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It defines the composition and powers of the Board responsible for controlling and managing the fund, as well as provisions regarding its audit and accounts.

name: Pakistan Institute of Prosthetic and Orthotic Sciences Act , 1999.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Institute of Prosthetic and Orthotic Sciences Act, 1999
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Institute of Prosthetic and Orthotic Sciences to impart education and training in orthopedic technology. The institute is empowered to coordinate with universities, develop training facilities, manage patient care centers, and regulate the establishment of prosthetic and orthotic service centers.

name: Shar'i Nizam-e-Adl Act, 1999.

metadata.title: The Shar'i Nizam-e-Adl Act, 1999
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a system of Shar'i Nizam-e-Adl through designated courts specifically in the Kohistan District of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It defines the roles and conduct of judicial officers, including Qazis, and stipulates that cases within this area shall be decided according to established principles of Shariah, with exceptions for non-Muslim personal law matters.

name: Irrigation and Drainage Authority Act, 1997.

metadata.title: The Irrigation and Drainage Authority Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Irrigation and Drainage Authority in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to streamline the province's irrigation and drainage systems. It aims to replace existing administrative setups with more efficient arrangements, ensure equitable water distribution, and transform the Provincial Irrigation Department into an autonomous authority.

name: Finance Act, 1997.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and revises the rates of certain taxes, duties, and fees in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It amends various existing provincial acts and ordinances to update stamp duty schedules and other financial provisions.

name: Consumers Protection Act, 1997

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Consumers Protection Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the promotion and protection of consumer interests in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes a Consumer Protection Council, defines key terms such as 'consumer' and 'defect', and outlines procedures for lodging complaints and seeking redressal through designated courts.

name: The Kaghan Development Authority Act, 2020.

metadata.title: The Kaghan Development Authority Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and reorganizes the Kaghan Development Authority to better manage the development of the Kaghan Valley and District Mansehra. It grants autonomy to the Authority, ensures private sector representation, and promotes tourism in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

name: Finance Act, 1995.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy, revision, and modification of certain taxes, fees, duties, and cesses in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes a development cess on marble and regulates the licensing of power crushers used for crushing stones and minerals.

name: Conduct of Examinations Eradication of Malpractices Act, 1995.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Conduct of Examinations (Eradication of Malpractices) Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the eradication of malpractices in examinations conducted by Universities and Boards in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It defines key terms related to examinations and outlines punishments for various offenses such as question paper leaks, answer book tampering, and impersonation.

name: Finance Act, 1994.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1994
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967; The Stamp Act, 1899; W.P. Act 1 of 1965; Ordinance No. IX of 1980
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy, reduction, and modification of certain taxes, fees, and duties in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province. It amends existing legislation including the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967, and the Stamp Act, 1899, to update definitions and stamp duty rates.

name: Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Application Of Laws) Regulation, 1994.

metadata.title: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1994
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies specific laws to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It stipulates that certain existing laws and rules shall apply to these areas while simultaneously causing corresponding local customs or instruments to cease operating.

name: Education Foundation Act, 1992.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Education Foundation Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Education Foundation as a body corporate to promote and finance private sector education development. It defines the composition of the Board of Directors, outlines their functions, and sets rules for management and governance within the province.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1990

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1990
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Development Cess Act, 1949; West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; Finance Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and revises certain taxes, cesses, and fees in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It amends existing legislation regarding stamp duties, development cess, motor vehicle taxation, and finance ordinances.

name: Salinity Control And Reclamation Of Land Act, 1988.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Salinity Control and Reclamation of Land Act, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the execution of schemes to drain sub-surface water and remove hindrances in installing sub-surface drains within Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes an Authority to frame these schemes, restricts the planting of deep-rooted trees or erection of structures over drains without permission, and outlines penalties for non-compliance.

name: Finance Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2016
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Act No. II of 1899; West Pakistan Act No. V of 1958; West Pakistan Act No. XXXII of 1958; West Pakistan Act No. XXXIV of 1964; West Pakistan Ordinance No. XIX of 1965; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1990; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XXI of 2013; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XVIII of 2013
metadata.summary: This Act levies, continues, and revises certain taxes and duties within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It amends various existing provincial and West Pakistan acts related to stamp duty, urban property tax, motor vehicle taxation, and general finance regulations.

name: Appointment of Gavi, Jica, Adhoc and Contract Employees Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Appointment of GAVI, JICA, Adhoc and Contract Employees Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of employees from the Global Alliance of Vaccination and Immunization (GAVI) and JICA projects on a regular basis. It also addresses the regularization of adhoc and contract employees, including medical officers and nurses, within the Health Department of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

name: Health Foundation Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Health Foundation Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Health Foundation as a body corporate to promote innovative healthcare delivery models. It provides for the constitution of a Board of Governors and outlines the foundation's powers, functions, and rules regarding public private partnerships.

name: The West Pakistan Fisheries Ordinance, 1961.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Fisheries Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to fisheries in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes regulations regarding the appointment of inspectors, leasing of water for fishing, issuance of permits, prohibition of destructive methods like explosives or poison, and penalties for offences.

name: THE NORTH WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE TENANCY (VALIDATION AND EXTENSION OF PERIOD FOR PAYMENT OF COMPENSATION) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Tenancy (Validation and Extension of Period for Payment of Compensation) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Tenancy (Fixation of Compensation to the Landlord) Rules, 1950
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Tenancy (Fixation of Compensation to the Landlord) Rules, 1950, and executive orders extending the payment period up to September 30, 1956. It further extends the deadline for occupancy tenants who failed to pay compensation to acquire proprietary rights in their tenancies.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Special Tribunal Act, 1948

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Special Tribunal Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Special Tribunals within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to ensure speedy trials and effective punishment for specific offences. It defines the composition of these tribunals, their jurisdiction over pending cases, and outlines the procedural rules they must follow during proceedings.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Protection of Trees and Brushwood Act, 1949.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Protection of Trees and Brushwood Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection of trees and brushwood belonging to the Government and Local Bodies in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It defines specific offences such as felling, damaging, or removing trees and establishes joint liability for villagers regarding penalties.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Adolescent) Prisoner's Release On Probation Act, 1948

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Adolescent) Prisoner's Release on Probation Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conditional release of adolescent prisoners from prison before their sentence is completed. It establishes the powers of the Provincial Government to grant licenses, define supervision conditions, and revoke such licenses.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Procurement of Food Grains Act, 1948

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Procurement of Foodgrains Act, 1948
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Tenancy Act XXV of 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the procurement of foodgrains at controlled prices within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes mechanisms for assessing yields, determining quantities to be surrendered by landlords and tenants, and setting payment rates for grain delivered to the government.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Development Cess Act, 1949

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Development Cess Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act levies a development cess on octroi, land revenue, and water rates within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The collected funds are applied to promote education and other purposes of general public utility.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Control of Bill Sticking Act, 1949.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Control of Bill Sticking Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act establishes control and regulation over bill sticking at public places within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It defines key terms such as 'Public Place' and 'Posting Bill', prescribes penalties for unauthorized affixing of advertisements, and empowers the Provincial Government to frame rules.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA TENANCY ACT, 1950

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Tenancy Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to land tenancy in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes definitions, regulates rent collection and alterations, and outlines procedures for tenant ejectment and compensation.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa New Irrigation Projects (Control and Prevention of Speculation in land) Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa New Irrigation Projects (Control and Prevention of Speculation in Land) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Provincial Government to control land purchases and prevent speculation in areas designated for new irrigation projects. It establishes mechanisms for appointing Collectors, valuing project lands, and annulling alienations made in contravention of the Act.

name: Race-Courses Licensing Act, 1912

metadata.title: The Race-Courses Licensing Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and licensing of race-courses within the Province of West Pakistan (specifically Sindh). It establishes definitions for horse-racing, outlines the process for applying for and granting licenses, prohibits racing on unlicensed grounds, and sets penalties for violations including unauthorized betting.

name: The Whipping Act, 1909

metadata.title: The Whipping Act, 1909
metadata.amends: Pakistan Penal Code
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the punishment of whipping in Pakistan. It specifies various offences under the Pakistan Penal Code, such as theft, rape, and dacoity, for which offenders are liable to be punished with whipping either in lieu of or in addition to other punishments.

name: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and abolishes various taxes and duties within the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes specific surcharges on agricultural income-tax, cinema tickets, motor vehicles, railway fares, and additional stamp duties for instruments of conveyance.

name: The West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Family Courts in each district to expedite the settlement of disputes relating to marriage and family affairs. It defines the qualifications for judges, outlines the jurisdiction of these courts, and specifies procedures for instituting suits and recording evidence.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN AGRICULTURAL BANK (RECOVERY OF DUES) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Bank (Recovery of Dues) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides facilities to the Agricultural Bank for recovering its dues. It allows agriculturists and co-operative societies to pledge, mortgage, hypothecate, or assign property to the bank to secure loans.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN DISTRICT (RECONSTITUTION) ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan District (Reconstitution) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the alteration of district limits and the constitution of new districts in West Pakistan. It grants the Government power to alter district boundaries or create new districts via notification, while specifying how existing laws apply to added areas.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN CONSOLIDATION OF HOLDINGS ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Consolidation of Holdings Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: law relating to consolidation of holdings in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law regarding the consolidation of land holdings in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes procedures for applications, schemes, and compensation related to redistributing lands within estates to reduce the number of plots.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN HISTORICAL MOSQUES [AND SHRINES] FUND CESS ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the raising of funds to support the repair, maintenance, and endowment of historically significant mosques and shrines in West Pakistan. It establishes a specific cess levied on urban immovable property tax payable by Muslims to finance these activities through a dedicated fund.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN PROHIBITION OF SMOKING IN CINEMA HOUSES ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits smoking in cinema houses within the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes penalties for offenders, grants police powers to arrest without a warrant, and allows management to post notices regarding the ban.

name: THE DIR (ADVISORY COUNCIL) REGULATION, 1960

metadata.title: The Dir (Advisory Council) Regulation, 1960
metadata.summary: This regulation establishes a Council of Advisors to aid and advise the Ruler of Dir in exercising his functions. It outlines the council's composition, the appointment of a Chief Advisor, and grants power to make rules for its implementation.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN UNDESIRABLE COMPANIES ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Undesirable Companies Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the registration of companies carrying on business for certain undesirable purposes, such as lottery schemes. It provides legal mechanisms for the winding up and dissolution of existing undesirable companies and mandates the cessation of their functions upon the Ordinance's commencement.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN USURIOUS LOANS ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Usurious Loans Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to usurious loans in the Province of West Pakistan. It empowers courts to reopen transactions, relieve debtors from excessive interest liability, and revise unfair agreements or securities.

name: The West Pakistan Government Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recovery of Government dues as arrears of land revenue in the Province of West Pakistan. It empowers the Government to declare specific dues recoverable under the Revenue Recoveries Act, 1890, and authorizes the making of rules to give effect to its provisions.

name: The West Pakistan (Universities) Removal of Undesirable Government Servants Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Universities) Removal of Undesirable Government Servants Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the termination of services of Government servants serving in universities and other educational institutions in West Pakistan who are deemed undesirable. It empowers the Governor to terminate such services after giving the servant a reasonable opportunity to show cause against the proposed action.

name: The West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance, 1962
metadata.number: W. P. ORD NO. VIII OF 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the levy of tolls on public roads and bridges in the Province of West Pakistan. It grants the Government powers to set up toll gates, lease out toll collection rights, and impose penalties for non-payment or unlawful acts.

name: The West Pakistan Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of a special agency known as the Anti-Corruption Establishment in West Pakistan. Its primary purpose is to investigate specific corruption offences committed by public servants and to conduct preliminary inquiries against them.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN RELIEF OF INDEBTEDNESS ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Relief of Indebtedness Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the relief of indebtedness in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes specific protections for agricultural debtors, including limits on recoverable interest, exemptions from arrest, and restrictions on the attachment or sale of their homes and essential assets.

name: Finance Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes, cesses, and surcharges in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It specifically addresses agricultural income-tax surcharges in specific districts, cinema taxes, motor vehicle tax surcharges, and enhancements to fees relating to motor vehicles.

name: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1962.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and abolishes certain taxes and duties in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes specific surcharges on land revenue and agricultural income tax in designated districts, increases stamp duties, and imposes taxes on cinemas, entertainment, professions, trades, motor vehicles, and betting.

name: The West Pakistan Institute of Textile Technology Cess Act, 1962.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Institute of Textile Technology Cess Act, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the raising of funds to establish and maintain the Pakistan Institute of Textile Technology in Lyallpur. It authorizes the government to levy a cess on textile mills based on installed spindles and looms, outlines assessment procedures, and establishes mechanisms for appeals and recovery.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA ANTIQUITIES ACT, 2016.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Antiquities Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides a legal framework for the protection, preservation, development, and maintenance of antiquities within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes various bodies such as the Conservation Heritage Board and regulates activities including excavation, trade, and export of cultural properties.

name: The Stamp Act, 1899

metadata.title: The Stamp Act, 1899
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to stamps in Pakistan. It establishes provisions for stamp duties on various instruments, rules for their execution and valuation, and penalties for non-compliance.

name: West Pakistan Laws (Adaptation) Order 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Laws (Adaptation) Order, 1964
metadata.summary: This Order authorizes the Governor of West Pakistan to adapt existing provincial laws to align with the Constitution. It specifies that these adapted laws shall continue in force until repealed or amended by the competent authority.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA (DISPOSAL OF CRIMINAL CASES AND REMOVAL OF DOUBT) ACT 1973

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Disposal of Criminal Cases and Removal of Doubt) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The North-West Frontier Province (Disposal of Criminal Cases and Removal of Doubt) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the disposal of cases pending under the Criminal Law (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1968, which had ceased to operate in specific areas. It also removes doubts regarding the application of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, to those areas and validates orders passed by courts after the cessation of the said Ordinance but before this Act commenced.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA (DISPOSAL OF CIVIL CASES AND REMOVAL OF DOUBT) ACT 1973

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Disposal of Civil Cases and Removal of Doubt) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The North-West Frontier Province (Disposal of Civil Cases and Removal of Doubt) Ordinance 1973 (N.W.F.P Ordinance, No. IV of 1973)
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the disposal of civil cases that were pending under the Civil Procedure (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1968, after that Ordinance ceased to operate. It also removes doubts regarding the application of the Evidence Act, 1872, and the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, to specific areas in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act 1973

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1973
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and abolishes certain taxes, cesses, and surcharges in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It specifically establishes a surcharge on agricultural income-tax for specific districts, introduces cinema tax rates, and imposes a surcharge on motor vehicle tax.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Gomal Zam Project (Control and Prevention of Speculation in Land) Ordinance 1971

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Gomal Zam Project (Control and Prevention of Speculation in Land) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to control land purchases and prevent speculation in the Gomal Zam Project Area. It establishes restrictions on alienating project land until fifteen years after water availability, defines speculative transactions, and empowers the government to acquire such lands with appropriate consideration.

name: WEST PAKISTAN REQUISITIONING OF STAGE CARRIAGES (TEMPORARY POWERS) ORDINANCE 1970

metadata.title: West Pakistan Requisitioning of Stage Carriages (Temporary Powers) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the temporary requisitioning of motor vehicles, specifically stage carriages, within West Pakistan. It grants District Magistrates the power to requisition vehicles, maintain them as stage carriages, and arrange for their release to owners upon completion.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Prohibition of Dancing Act, 1974.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Prohibition of Dancing Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits women from dancing in public places within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes penalties including fines and imprisonment for offenders, grants police powers to enter premises and arrest violators, and outlines procedures for cognizance of offences.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN ENTERTAINMENTS DUTY ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the levy of a duty on admission to entertainments in West Pakistan. It establishes specific rates for the entertainment duty based on the payment amount and defines key terms such as 'entertainment', 'Government', and 'Collector'.

name: The Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903

metadata.title: The Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903
metadata.repeals: Enactments specified in the schedule
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the Court of Wards in the Punjab Province. It establishes the constitution, jurisdiction, and powers of the Court regarding the superintendence of properties and persons of wards.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Salinity Control and Reclamation of Land Ordinance, 1986.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Salinity Control and Reclamation of Land Ordinance, 1986
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the execution of schemes to drain sub-surface water and remove hindrances in installing sub-surface drains within Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes an Authority to frame these schemes and grants powers to restrict planting deep-rooted trees or erecting structures that may harm drainage systems without prior permission.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Restricting the Sale of the Holy Quran Act, 1939.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Restricting the Sale of the Holy Quran Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act restricts the printing, publishing, and selling of the Holy Quran to Muslims only to prevent errors and protect religious susceptibilities. It imposes fines or imprisonment on non-Muslims who violate these provisions while allowing existing stockholders one year to dispose of their inventory.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Fair Price Shops (Factories) Ordinance, 1983.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Fair Price Shops (Factories) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment and maintenance of fair price shops in certain factories within Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to sell essential articles at cheaper rates to workers. It defines key terms such as 'fair price', 'essential articles', and 'worker', and outlines the duties of employers, the constitution of managing committees, and the appointment of inspectors.

name: The West Pakistan Hill Tract Improvement Ordinance, 1961.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Hill Tract Improvement Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the improvement and expansion of galies and other areas in the hill tract of the District of Hazara.
