It establishes a Trust with specific powers regarding land acquisition, street alignment, building regulations, and financial management to facilitate development.

name: The West Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Act, 1958.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the maintenance of certain essential services in West Pakistan. It empowers the Government to order persons engaged in specific employments to remain in designated areas and regulates their wages and conditions of service.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Refugees (Registration of Land Claims) Act, 1949.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Refugees (Registration of Land Claims) Act, 1949
metadata.repeals: N.W.F.P Tenancy Act 1950 (XXV of 1950)
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration of land claims by refugees settled in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa who abandoned their land due to civil disturbances or partition. It establishes the powers of Settlement Officers, defines key terms like 'Refugee' and 'Land', and outlines procedures for submitting claims and penalties for false information.

name: Control of Advertisements relating to Medicines Act, 1946.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Control of Advertisements relating to Medicines Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act establishes control over advertisements relating to medicines within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It regulates the publication of such advertisements in public places, newspapers, and periodicals, specifically prohibiting claims regarding cures for venereal diseases or miscarriage prevention without permission.

name: Table Water Act, 1939.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Table Waters Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the imposition and collection of an excise duty on table waters manufactured in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes rules regarding the issue of waters from manufactories, the use of banderols or stamps, licensing requirements, and penalties for contravention.

name: Dadar Tuberculosis Sanatorium (Prohibition of Buildings) Act, 1939.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Dadar Tuberculosis Sanatorium (Prohibition of Buildings) Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the control of building construction near the Dadar Tuberculosis Sanatorium to prevent health hazards. It requires previous sanction from the Provincial Government before erecting or re-erecting any building within the designated area and outlines specific conditions regarding ventilation, drainage, and structural safety.

name: The Hazara Settlement Rules Repeal Regulation, 1901.

metadata.title: The Hazara Settlement Rules Repeal Regulation, 1901
metadata.repeals: Punjab Frontier Regulation, 1872; Hazara Settlement Rules Amendment Regulation, Reg: II of 1874; Hazara Settlement Rules, Reg: I of 1872
metadata.summary: This Regulation repeals the unrepealed portions of the Punjab Frontier Regulation, 1872, and the Hazara Settlement Rules. It also clarifies the legal force of entries in the record-of-rights for the first regular settlement of the Hazara District.

name: The Punjab Excise Act, 1914.

metadata.title: The Punjab Excise Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law in Punjab relating to the import, export, transport, manufacture, sale, and possession of intoxicating liquor and drugs. It establishes the framework for excise administration, licensing, duties, and penalties for various offences.

name: The Cotton Ginning and Pressing Factories Act, 1925.

metadata.title: The Cotton Ginning and Pressing Factories Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better regulation of cotton ginning and cotton pressing factories. It establishes requirements for maintaining specific registers, marking bales, and outlines penalties for non-compliance or false entries.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN (ADAPTATION AND REPEAL OF LAWS) ACT, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Adaptation and Repeal of Laws) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act adapts and repeals certain laws applicable to the Province of West Pakistan. It provides for grammatical changes, defines key terms such as 'Administration' and 'Existing Law', and outlines how references to former territories or authorities should be construed after the establishment of the province.

name: The Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collections ) Act, 1953

metadata.title: The Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collections) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation, administration, and accounting of collections of charitable donations. It also aims to prevent frauds related to such collections.

name: The West Pakistan Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the temporary requisitioning of immovable property by the Provincial Government for the use of Central, Provincial, or corporate bodies. It outlines the procedures for issuing requisition orders, exemptions for religious and educational buildings, and the process for releasing property and assessing compensation.

name: The Provincial Motor Vehicle Ordinance, 1965.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the legal framework for the licensing of drivers and the registration of motor vehicles within West Pakistan. It also outlines regulations regarding transport permits, vehicle maintenance standards, and traffic control measures.

name: The West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the maintenance and restoration of order in areas affected by specific calamities. It also establishes measures for the prevention, control, and relief against such disasters including floods, famines, and fires.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2015
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Urban Immoveable Property Tax Act, 1958; West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1996; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act continues, alters, and exempts certain taxes and cess in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It amends several existing acts, including the West Pakistan Urban Immoveable Property Tax Act, 1958, and the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes the bonded labour system in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to prevent economic and physical exploitation. It declares all agreements, customs, and obligations related to bonded labour void and extinguishes liability for bonded debts.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Board of Investment and Trade Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Board of Investment and Trade Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Board of Investment and Trade as a body corporate within the province. Its purpose is to promote, encourage, and facilitate investors while coordinating with federal and provincial departments for policy reforms and sustainable economic growth.

name: Establishment of Civil Mobile Courts Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Establishment of Civil Mobile Courts Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Civil Mobile Courts in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province to ensure inexpensive and expeditious disposal of certain claims and disputes. It defines the jurisdiction, powers, and procedures for these courts, including provisions for alternate dispute resolution with local elders and advocates.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN AGRICULTURAL PESTS ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Pests Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the eradication of agricultural pests in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes the powers of the Government and Inspectors, defines terms such as 'agricultural pest' and 'infested crop', and outlines obligations for land occupiers regarding preventive measures.

name: The West Pakistan Suppression of Prostitution Ordinance, 1961.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Suppression of Prostitution Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the suppression of prostitution in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as brothel, prostitution, and public place, and prescribes punishments for keeping brothels, soliciting, and living on earnings from prostitution.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to preventive detention and the control of persons and publications in West Pakistan. It grants government powers to arrest, detain, and investigate suspected individuals acting prejudicial to public safety or order, while also regulating publications and prohibiting entry of certain newspapers.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN PROHIBITION OF OPIUM SMOKING ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the prohibition of opium smoking in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines key terms, prohibits the manufacture, possession, or use of opium and related apparatus, and outlines penalties for offences along with powers granted to excise officers.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN GOATS (RESTRICTION) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Goats (Restriction) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to restrict the number of goats in the Province of West Pakistan for public interest. It grants the Government powers to regulate grazing, movement, and slaughter of goats through notifications and rules, while establishing penalties for contravention.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN JUVENILE SMOKING ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Juvenile Smoking Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The North-West Frontier Province Juvenile Smoking Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law regarding the prevention of tobacco smoking by juveniles in West Pakistan. It establishes penalties for selling tobacco to minors, authorizes the seizure of tobacco found with juveniles in public places, and repeals previous related enactments.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN HINDU WOMEN’S RIGHTS TO AGRICULTURAL LAND ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Hindu Women's Rights to Agricultural Land Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The North-West Frontier Province Hindu Women's Rights to Property (extension of Agricultural Land) Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the Hindu Law governing women's rights to agricultural land in the Province of West Pakistan. It specifically addresses the devolution of such land when a Hindu dies intestate, granting widows specific shares or interests depending on the school of law they are governed by.

name: The West Pakistan Muslim personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1962.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1962
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Limitation (Custom) Act, 1920; The Punjab Custom (Power to Contest) Act, 1920; The Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1937, in its application to West Pakistan; The [Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1935; The Punjab Muslim Personal law (Shariat)Application. Act 1948; The Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Sindh Amendment) Act, 1950; The Bahawalpur State Shariat (Muslim Personal Law) Application Act, 1951; The Khairpur State Muslim Female Inheritance (Removal of Customs) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the provisions regarding the application of Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) in the Province of West Pakistan. It terminates limited estates under Customary Law for Muslim females and alters the devolution of property upon the termination of life estates or wills.

name: The West Pakistan General Clauses (Extension to Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan General Clauses (Extension to [Tribal] Areas) Regulation, 1961
metadata.amends: General Clauses Act, 1897
metadata.summary: This Regulation extends the provisions of the General Clauses Act, 1897 to the Tribal Areas of West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan with the previous approval of the President for the purposes of peace and good government.

name: Dir (Extension of Laws) Regulation, 1961.

metadata.title: The Dir (Extension of Laws) Regulation, 1961
metadata.summary: This Regulation extends specific enactments and rules from West Pakistan to the territories of the State of Dir. It stipulates that any corresponding laws previously in force in Dir shall cease to have effect upon this extension.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Small Industries Development Board Act, 1972.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Small Industries Development Board Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Small Industries Development Board in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to promote industrial development, particularly for small and cottage industries. It provides for the constitution, management, and functions of the Board, including powers to grant loans and manage funds.

name: The Pakistan Day Memorial Cess (West Pakistan) Act, 1964

metadata.title: The Pakistan Day Memorial Cess (West Pakistan) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a cess on cinema and race-course tickets to raise funds for the Pakistan Day Memorial in Lahore. It creates a committee responsible for constructing the memorial and managing a dedicated fund, with provisions for the committee's dissolution once construction is complete.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF GOONDAS ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the control of disorderly persons commonly known as goondas in West Pakistan. It establishes a Tribunal with specific powers to conduct inquiries, summon witnesses, and issue orders against declared goondas.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA HIGHWAYS ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Highways Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to highways in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes Highway Authorities, defines their powers regarding encroachments and road works, regulates vehicle usage, and outlines procedures for penalties.

name: The West Pakistan Land- Revenue Act, 1967

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for land revenue administration in West Pakistan, including the division into districts and the appointment of revenue officers. It outlines procedures for assessing land revenue, maintaining records of rights, and collecting payments through various legal processes.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Wildlife and Biodiversity (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Wildlife and Biodiversity (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the laws relating to the protection, preservation, conservation, and management of wildlife and biodiversity in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes organizations such as the Wildlife Force and the Board, defines restrictions on hunting and trade, and outlines penalties for offenses against wildlife.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (TEVTA) to oversee technical education and vocational skills training in the province. It grants TEVTA the power to take administrative and regulatory control over public sector technical institutions while excluding colleges of commerce, business administration, or management sciences.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA SHOPS AND ESTABLISHMENT ACT, 2015.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Shops and Establishments Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides a legal framework for the hours and other conditions of work and employment in shops, commercial, industrial, and other establishments within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It defines key terms such as 'employee', 'employer', and 'commercial establishment', while establishing regulations regarding weekly holidays, leave entitlements, wage payment, and penalties for violations.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Sensitive and Vulnerable Establishments and Places (Security) Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Sensitive and Vulnerable Establishments and Places (Security) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the security of sensitive and other vulnerable establishments and places within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It aims to curb terrorist activities by establishing a Security Advisory Committee at the district level to identify, categorize, and inspect these locations.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Protection of Breast-Feeding and Child Nutrition Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Protection of Breast-Feeding and Child Nutrition Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection of breast-feeding and adequate nutrition for infants and young children in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It regulates the marketing and promotion of designated products, including breast milk substitutes and feeding equipment, while establishing administrative bodies like the Infant Feeding Board.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Prohibition of Employment of Children Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Prohibition of Employment of Children Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the employment of children and regulates the employment of adolescents in hazardous occupations within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It establishes committees, sets working hours and conditions for adolescents, and outlines penalties and procedures for offences related to child labour violations.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Medical Teaching Institutions Reforms Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Medical Teaching Institutions Reforms Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides autonomy to government-owned Medical Teaching Institutions and their affiliated teaching hospitals in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It aims to regulate services on sound physical and technical footings while improving performance, effectiveness, efficiency, and responsiveness for quality healthcare provision.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons (Regularization of Services) Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons (Regularization of Services) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons appointed on adhoc and contract basis in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government hospitals between 2011 and 2013. It deems these officers validly appointed on a regular basis from the date of commencement, subject to specific conditions regarding qualifications and commission recommendations.

name: THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA LISSAAIL-E-WAL MAHROOM FOUNDATION ACT, 2015.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Lissaail-e-Wal Mahroom Foundation Act, 2015
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Deserving Widows and Special Persons Welfare Foundation Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Lissaail-e-Wal Mahroom Foundation as a body corporate to provide financial assistance for health, education, and welfare to indigent and dispossessed persons. It outlines the constitution of a Board, defines key terms including widows and persons with disabilities, and sets objectives to synergize charity activities and support philanthropists.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Health Care Commission Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Health Care Commission Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Health Care Commission to regulate health care services in both public and private sectors. It aims to ensure safe, high-quality health care by banning quackery and setting standards for medical establishments.

name: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the imposition of tax on motor vehicles in West Pakistan. It establishes obligations for vehicle owners to declare their vehicles, pay quarterly taxes, and obtain licenses.

name: The West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance) Act, 1958.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Ordinance, 1946; Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Act, 1947; Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers Ordinance, 1955; West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of certain powers in relation to requisitioned land following the expiration of previous Defence of India Act provisions. It outlines the procedures for releasing land from requisition, acquiring such land by the government, and determining compensation or liability.

name: The West Pakistan Mineral Development Corporation Act, 1958.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Mineral Development Corporation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the West Pakistan Mineral Development Corporation to promote mineral development in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines the corporation's structure, including its board of directors, share capital, and the powers vested in the Board for general administration.

name: The West Pakistan Agriculturists Loans Act, 1958.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: Agriculturists Loans Act, 1884; Agriculturists' Loans (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1951; Agriculturists' Loans (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1955; Agriculturists' Loans (Sindh-Amendment) Act, 1941; Khairpur State Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1952; West Pakistan Agriculturists' Loans Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law regarding the advancement and recovery of taccavi loans for agricultural purposes in West Pakistan. It grants the government power to make rules concerning loan types, seed sales on credit, and establishes procedures for recovering loans as arrears of land revenue.

name: The Punjab Soil Reclamation Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Punjab Soil Reclamation Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the speedy reclamation and improvement of areas damaged by thur and sem. It establishes a Board as a body corporate to oversee these activities, including powers for land acquisition, scheme formulation, and levy of reclamation fees.

name: The Cotton Industry (Statistics) Act, 1926.

metadata.title: The Cotton Industry (Statistics) Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regular submission of returns regarding quantities of cotton goods manufactured and cotton yarn spun in Pakistan. It grants officers the power to inspect mills, verify records, and publish monthly statements of production while establishing penalties for falsifying records or failing to submit required returns.

name: The Good Conduct Prisoner's Probational Release Act, 1926.

metadata.title: The Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conditional release of good conduct prisoners from prison before their sentence is completed. It establishes the power of the Provincial Government to grant licenses for release under specific conditions and outlines procedures for revoking such licenses or punishing absconders.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Sikh Religious Endowment Act, 1944

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Sikh Religious Endowment Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better administration of Sikh Gurdwaras, Dharamsalas, and religious endowments in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes District and Provincial committees to manage these institutions, defines key terms like 'Gurdwara' and 'Trustee', and outlines their powers, functions, and financial regulations.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Industrial Loans Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province Industrial Loans Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act improves the law relating to loans advanced by the Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa for industrial purposes. It outlines procedures for applying for loans, providing security, repaying amounts with interest, and handling defaults through notices and declarations.

name: The Multi-unit Co-operative Societies Act, 1942

metadata.title: The Multi-unit Co-operative Societies Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the incorporation, regulation, and winding up of co-operative societies whose objectives are not confined to a single province. It applies to societies incorporated before or after the commencement of this Act under previous provincial laws.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Requisitioning of Immovable Property for Defence Purposes Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Requisitioning of Immovable Property for Defence Purposes Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the requisitioning and retention of immovable property within Khyber Pakhtunkhwa for the purpose of the defence of Pakistan. It establishes procedures for serving notices, vesting property in the government, determining compensation through agreement or arbitration, and delegating powers to the Provincial Government.

name: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Finance Corporation (Recovery of Arrears) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Finance Corporation (Recovery of Arrears) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Finance Corporation (Recovery of Arrears) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides facilities to the Agricultural Development Finance Corporation for recovering its dues. It allows agricultural concerns to pledge or mortgage property to secure loans and empowers the Corporation to recover dues by disposing of such property.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the levy of a tax on urban immovable property in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes provisions for defining terms, levying taxes based on annual rental value, creating valuation lists, and outlining procedures for collection, appeals, and penalties.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Board of Technical Education Act, 1972

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Board of Technical Education Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes and organizes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Board of Technical Education. It establishes the Board as a body corporate with powers to acquire property and defines its members, officers, and functions regarding technical, vocational, industrial, and commercial education.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN URBAN RENT RESTRICTION ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to restrict the increase of rent for certain premises within urban areas in West Pakistan and to limit the eviction of tenants from such properties. It establishes definitions for key terms like 'building', 'tenant', and 'Controller', and outlines provisions regarding fair rent determination, exemptions, and penalties for non-compliance.

name: The West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was enacted to amend and consolidate the law relating to Civil Courts in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes classes of civil courts, defines their jurisdiction, and outlines provisions regarding appointments and powers of judicial officers.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN MONEY-LENDERS ORDINANCE, 1960.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Money Lenders Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to money-lenders, their registration, and the regulation of their accounts in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes provisions for licensing, account keeping, interest computation, and penalties for various offenses related to money-lending activities.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN PURE FOOD ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Pure Food Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the preparation and sale of foods in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes definitions for various food items, prohibits the sale of adulterated or unwholesome food, and outlines penalties and procedures for enforcement.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN SURVEY AND RECTANGULATION OF LANDS ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Survey and Rectangulation of Lands Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the survey and rectangulation of lands in the Province of West Pakistan. It empowers the Board of Revenue to direct these operations, assess associated costs, and prescribe penalties for obstruction or non-compliance.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 1980
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Rules, 1969; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 1977; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues and levies certain taxes, cesses, and surcharges in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province. It amends existing legislation regarding stamp duties, urban immovable property tax, motor vehicle taxation, and fees while omitting specific sections from previous acts.

name: Finance Ordinance, 1983

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 1983
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; West Pakistan Motor Vehicles taxation Act, 1958; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance IX of 1980
metadata.repeals: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act XVII of 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues, levies, and abolishes certain taxes, cesses, and fees in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It establishes the registration requirements for private schools and amends existing acts regarding urban immovable property and motor vehicle taxation.

name: Finance Ordinance, 1982

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 1982
metadata.amends: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 1982
metadata.repeals: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ord. XII of 1978
metadata.summary: This ordinance establishes the authority to levy specific taxes, cesses, and fees within Khyber Pakhtunkhwa for development purposes. It details the rates and collection methods for sugar-cane and sugar-beet development cesses while repealing a previous section of the North-West Frontier Province Finance Ordinance, 1978.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Electricity (Temporary Powers Of Control) Act, 1947

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Electricity (Temporary Powers of Control) Act, 1947
metadata.repeals: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Electricity (Temporary Powers of Control) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of temporary powers to control the production, supply, and distribution of electricity in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It grants the Provincial Government authority to issue orders regulating or prohibiting electricity activities and establishes penalties for contravention.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Essential Articles Control (Temporary Powers) Act, 1947

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Essential Articles Control (Temporary Powers) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Provincial Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to regulate the production, supply, distribution, transport, and prices of essential articles. It provides for the issuance of orders to control trade and commerce in these items during times when immediate action is deemed necessary.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Requisitioning of Buildings (Rationing), Act, 1947

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Requisitioning of Buildings (Rationing) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Provincial Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to requisition buildings for rationing purposes. It establishes procedures for determining compensation payable to owners, including the appointment of arbitrators and the handling of appeals to the High Court.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Prevention Of Hindus Bigamous Marriages Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Prevention of Hindus Bigamous Marriages Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of bigamous marriages among Hindus within the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It declares such marriages void and establishes penalties for contracting, solemnizing, or promoting them, including specific provisions regarding minors.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Warehouses Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Warehouses Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act regulates licensed warehouses in the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to encourage their establishment and ensure proper supervision. It provides for the licensing process, duties of warehousemen regarding stored products, inspection procedures, and penalties for violations.

name: The Public Health (Emergency Provisions) Ordinance, 1944

metadata.title: The Public Health (Emergency Provisions) Ordinance, 1944
metadata.summary: This Ordinance makes special provisions to prevent the spread of human disease and safeguard public health during an emergency. It empowers the appropriate Government to direct local authorities, appoint additional staff, assume superintendence of services, and modify rules as necessary.

name: The Co-operative Societies Act, 1925

metadata.title: THE CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES ACT, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act governs the registration, rights, liabilities, and duties of cooperative societies in Sind. It outlines procedures for winding up societies, arbitration processes, and penalties for offenses related to society management.

name: Restriction of Habitual Offenders (Punjab) Act, 1918

metadata.title: The Restriction of Habitual Offenders (Punjab) Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal provisions to restrict the movements of habitual offenders within the province and requires them to report themselves at specified times and places. It outlines the procedures for magistrates to make orders of restriction, issue warrants, and handle appeals related to these restrictions.

name: Forestry Commission Act, 1999

metadata.title: The Forestry Commission Act, 1999
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Forestry Commission to oversee the protection, management, and sustainable development of forests in the province. It defines the composition of the Commission, including non-official members and ex-officio representatives, and outlines the functions of the Commission and a related Forestry Round Table.

name: The Punjab Minor Canals Act, 1905

metadata.title: The Punjab Minor Canals Act, 1905
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better control and management of minor canals in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It outlines powers regarding construction, water supply regulation, dispute settlement, and compensation for land acquisition related to canal operations.

name: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of powers to control the supply, distribution, and movement of foodstuffs in West Pakistan. It also regulates trade and commerce in these commodities through various government orders.

name: The West Pakistan Vaccination Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Vaccination Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to vaccination in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes duties for local authorities, parents, and guardians regarding the vaccination of children and persons against vaccine-preventable diseases.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN BOARD OF REVENUE ACT, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Board of Revenue Act, 1957
metadata.repeals: W. P. Ord. XII of 1956
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Board of Revenue for West Pakistan to oversee the administration of land, collection of revenue, and preparation of land records. It defines the Board's powers as the highest court of appeal and revision in revenue cases within the province.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities Act, 2012

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and reorganizes universities established or to be established by the Government of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It aims to improve governance and management through accountability, transparency, and stakeholder representation to enhance higher education quality.

name: Control of Public Utility Services Act, 1938

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Utility Services Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Provincial Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to control public utility services, including industries supplying light or water and systems of conservancy. It grants the government authority to issue orders requiring specific actions or assuming control of services deemed necessary for public advantage.

name: Famine Relief Fund Act, 1938

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Famine Relief Fund Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Famine Relief Fund to maintain a financial reserve for disaster relief. It outlines the fund's composition, annual contributions, permissible uses for famine and drought relief, and procedures for investment and accounting.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa New Irrigation Projects (Planned Development) Act, 1953

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa New Irrigation Projects (Planned Development) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the speedy and planned development of areas brought under new irrigation projects in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It also establishes the authority to levy development fees for these schemes.

name: The West Pakistan General Clauses Act, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan General Clauses Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the interpretation of West Pakistan Acts and shortens the language used therein. It provides general rules for the construction of such Acts and covers matters relating to orders, rules, and other provisions applicable to enactments in force in West Pakistan.

name: The Prevention of Corruption Act (West Pakistan Extension) Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The Prevention of Corruption Act, (West Pakistan Extension) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.amends: The Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 to the whole of West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan on December 20, 1958, pursuant to a Presidential Proclamation from October 7, 1958.

name: The West Pakistan Departmental Inquiries (Powers) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Departmental Inquiries (Powers) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Departmental Inquiries (Powers) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act confers powers on officers conducting departmental inquiries against government servants in West Pakistan to compel witness attendance and document production. It grants these officers the same powers exercisable by a civil court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, while specifying that processes must be served and executed by the relevant civil court.

name: THE SOCIETIES REGISTRATION ACT, 1860

metadata.title: The Societies Registration Act, 1860
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration of literary, scientific, and charitable societies in British India. It outlines the requirements for forming a society through a memorandum of association, including filing fees and annual lists of governing bodies.

name: The West Pakistan Graveyards (Preservation and Maintenance) Act, 1958.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Graveyards (Preservation and Maintenance) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the preservation and maintenance of graveyards in West Pakistan. It establishes a Committee to investigate encroachments, appoints a Tribunal to resolve title disputes, and outlines procedures for defining graveyard limits and acquiring land.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Abolition Of Haq-I-Tora Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Abolition of Haq-i-Tora Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes the practice of levying Haq-i-Tora in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa during betrothal, marriage, or other religious and social ceremonies. It defines key terms such as 'Haq-i-Tora' and establishes penalties for anyone who infringes upon its provisions.

name: THE DRAMATIC PERFORMANCES ACT, 1876

metadata.title: The Dramatic Performances Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Provincial Government to prohibit public dramatic performances that are scandalous, defamatory, seditious, or obscene. It outlines procedures for serving prohibition orders, notifying the public, and imposing penalties on those who disobey such orders or assist in prohibited performances.

name: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 1984

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Development Cess Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance levies a cess on fees or taxes collected by District Councils regarding the export of goods and animals. It amends the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Development Cess Act, 1949 to specify a rate of 12.5 paisa per rupee for such exports.

name: Katchi Abadis Act, 1996.

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Katchi Abadis Act, 1996
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularisation, development, and improvement of Katchi Abadis in the Province of North West Frontier (now Khyber Pakhtunkhwa). It establishes a Director General to oversee policies, conduct surveys, manage funds, and implement schemes for the infrastructure and resettlement of occupants.

name: Shari Act, 2003

metadata.title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Shari Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the supremacy of Shariat within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province and mandates that all provincial laws be interpreted in accordance with it. It outlines measures for integrating Islamic jurisprudence into the education system, reforming the economy on Islamic lines, and ensuring government observance of Sharia commands.
